notes.title: New Hero DLC & New Game
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone!

We are so happy to announce our third game - [b]Fallen Fates[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="SzmrRiz65cc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
The game is [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hibernian-workshop/fallen-fates"]now on Kickstarter[/url] and you can also [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3276270/Fallen_Fates/"]wishlist it here[/url] !

We have planned a ton of physical and digital rewards with access to early builds and much more![/p][p][/p][p]But that's not all, we are extremely happy to announce that Astral Ascent will get a [b]new hero DLC coming in 2026[/b] from Fallen Fates that will be [b]voiced by Ben Starr[/b].

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/380da1328638464329466eecec0dd8ba59dfe929.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Arven will be coming with his own playstyle, set of spells and weapons![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/751d18ba2e6f35b0be7a15054621f4bb7e051697.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]This Astral Ascent DLC will be free if you support the[url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hibernian-workshop/fallen-fates"] Fallen Fates campaign[/url][/b], so don't hesitate to support us there for that and many other rewards![/p][p][/p][p]Also no worries for Astral Ascent, many updates are coming, the [b]next one should be early October[/b] and we are super happy to announce [b]we are working on Steam Workshop features[/b] coming this year![/p][p]And we are making good progress on the Animals pets as you can see below![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/a0900353e3818825ebf05b2578ca59f0453e1dcd.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/3323362413487fe8ab6326473c2100a6aff2e48e.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/a4fd29902ba3011d2648c1c7273a591c36a2e0f4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Wishing you all an excellent day ! ːzimzimSmileː

- The Hibernian Workshop Team[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 2.2 is live now!
notes.notes:
[h1]Poetic Pandemonium update![/h1][p][/p][p]We hope your summer is going great, on our side we are back with a new major update! ːzagplsː

Take a look to the full Patch Notes below -

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/523100258247377423"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h1]Hub Customization[/h1][p]
A new NPC appeared in The Garden, The Yalee Builder!

[img src="https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcDFlc2Z4MWxidHlhaG94czFoMGJhM3l2bWp1ODVkY2h4MWJ0N2duZCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/7PdKXX5BU4f8jJ9Ttw/giphy.gif"][/img]
We hesitated for a long time to call this NPC "Leonardo Da Yalee" but thought it may not be fitting very well with the rest of the game, but at least you know it now haha

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/b1c28a727802c6feeda3b9110039dfe93e5e1d56.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You will have many places where you can add new assets, this feature was voted a lot by our Discord community about how to handle the extra Sun Pieces in late game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/5a2da0a167bc0037bf18959e86c3d3e489423ab9.jpg"][/img][/p][p](We also noted other suggestions for later! ːtaurusSmirkː)

But while making this new system it appeared to us that a Sun Piece payment for these changes was not the best option because : [/p][list][*][p]New players could favorize Decorations over meta progression making them weaker for chosing this[/p][/*][*][p]It will unbalance the overall meta progression[/p][/*][*][p]People would only buy a few elements they really want and not have many elements to choose from[/p][/*][*][p]People with a lot of sun pieces would still exhaust the options very very fast and still be super rich[/p][/*][/list][p]For these reasons it made much more sense to us to attach thse new decorations to challenges so you will often unlock new ones and have several to choose from. Also, no worries, if you are far into the progression you should unlock most of the rewards directly.

But we will find ways to spend the Sun Pieces for late game players no worries!

There is [b]7 Decorations families[/b] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]Under the Moon[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Inside the Reef[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Deep in the Dune[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Beyond Soft Melancholia[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]In the Observatory[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Near the Pinnacle[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Behind Parnassus[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]

Here are a few examples -[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/a6e20fc86c797ccef63d621d87945625db9e7c7b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/fe2775b4bf34ad69edfc9e167f60890072cbe5b4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/eeab316ae4a3201b2c2a9305890ed7fa3779b44f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/56a28e55fd211b86daf44e8ecdd751ce59d9acbc.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/93f8a6bff82bc696ecbca192e56233c50b18f866.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/e73f961b86b8efa5b6ecbefbcc1bd9d934e38b38.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/96669de0be654ba72a2f2423671817c447c8f25b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]That's just [b]6 examples[/b] out of a total of [b]84 beautiful[/b] assets to unlock and select to customize your hub![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]13 new spells -[/h1][p][/p][p]Ayla, Kiran, Calie & Octave are getting [b]2 new spells[/b] and many of you asked for Yamat to get more spells as she had a bit less than the others so we gave her [b]5 new spells[/b] instead of 2 ːtaffyː[/p][h2]Ayla Spells[/h2][list][*][p][b]N360 Death Lotus[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/oD9AN4btJYmG80pirM/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]N1000 Thousand Cuts[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/jDadXhsZpACl9tklAt/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Kiran Spells[/h2][list][*][p][b]Crater Maker[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/AN4RMu6UIlNXkvDje4/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Kiran Comet![/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/DGuSBj2ZDGgoDZUiPS/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Calie Spells[/h2][list][*][p][b]Kuzite Scythe - Quake[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/O1R7eB7FKtoJywHJZO/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Opulent Waltz[/b] [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/6oBuloUf2KQmQngSNG/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Octave Spells[/h2][list][*][p][b]Osculum Vale[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/ONcJsrNpCWjoEgLbKD/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Infinitus[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/OQl5AyiwZYaqw6DpZa/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Yamat Spells[/h2][list][*][p][b]Raging Bull[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/h8pFtCWBhmJo4qKpW9/giphy.gif"][/img]
[/p][list][*][p][b]Starburst[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/Ym7V9MEW4I0Y44khnt/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Serpentine Strike[/b] [/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/2yCjITt89SZrOIGmy1/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Feeding Frenzy[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/RtOq9pSn5ujtB1vQh4/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Fowl Plumage[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/0wwGlcRLqWhcHnsFQ8/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][p]In 2.2, all spells were reviewed to ensure an accurate display of average damage and hits. These updates do not impact the way the spells function, only the displayed information on the spell. In addition to the informational updates, many spells received additional changes. 2 and 3 cost spells were the focus of these changes as they were not providing enough damage for their cost when compared to 1 cost spells.[/p][p][/p][p]A large number of spells received rebalancing to ensure that no matter what you enjoy using, it will be effective.
[/p][p][b]N°539 FREEDOM FIGHTER[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/db7275040cbd90dbf1e556ebc48ee073b36442a2.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZXdlYWNvcWg0N3Zxc3Q2dnkzNHplMDVzOTNiN2VqN3QxcDlqZnhzaSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/Bu4NWrB6ftdfiyRBU2/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]TWIN DRAGON UPPERCUT[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/156f9821feea8f73c245baf797f037ea7568c564.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExeTN6NmxxYmphOWllOWYzeXluYXc0dWFrNnM5b3lmYW53bzJ4a2N1OCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/Qjew7VZayDWPlQDeS7/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[b]PERFORATIO[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/f6a4651176298f07a4a477cd4700d336669584c2.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNDg3am9xbm9tNjMwbHk2ODI1bWlnM3d1cXR1enc0OGx4b2JncWh4dyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/lEX0jGN4CA9fQnHGKo/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]AZURITE FALCHIONS - PIERCE[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/467e80863309cbc65d1457f618c9be62d664128e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNHpoNjA2amV4dG5pcjBkaDRjZjVvemJpNnJiM24zeDY0YjM4dTB1eiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/2aJV4gYZPQgP2Xgt06/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[b]STERN PRESENCE[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/61c8a597b294a2e2ec419c852ab451280ae2264b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExN2UwM2szd3RuaXRsdTRhcHo3cGFmN3A3NGw3Yjk3dW1qdjgzY294OCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/c4YynGxNDR2RG9pKJy/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]COMMON SPELLS[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/eb382864faa05b02c0609100e550bff88878dff2.png"][/img]
[b]ZODIAC SPELLS[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/c33441140785365b908f8fe84b871a74cc83bd44.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We have collaborated with players with hundreds of hours on the game to make these balancing changes as accurate and fair as possible.

We have also addressed many bugs reported by the community and we will keep fixing more with time![/p][p][/p][h1]What is coming next?[/h1][p][/p][p]You may have noticed that our updates 2.1 and 2.2 have been a slightly smaller than previous updates and that is partly because we are preparing the [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hibernian-workshop/fallen-fates"]Kickstarter campaign[/url] launching in September for our new game [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3276270/Fallen_Fates/"]Fallen Fates[/url], if you haven't already do not hesitate to follow the Kickstarter campaign as we will have a lot of reveals and exciting things during the campaign!
But we have also been having new team members who had to take their marks on Astral Ascent which is a huge project now! 

So our plan for the future is not to slow down but on the opposite [b]trying to make a lot of new content and improvements to the game[/b] you love and that we love just as much ːzimzimSmileː We already have a ton of ideas for partnerships with great games, features and more! 

We often said that as long as the game keeps selling we will keep making updates and the love and support you are showing is truly motivating us a lot!

If you ever want to support us you can leave a review on the game or on the DLCs pages and talk to your friend about the game, thanks again!!! ːzagplsː[/p][p][/p][h2]Steam Workshop[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/2895cd661496bb17521e6e5999af773c5bcc98f6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A lot of you have been asking about Steam Workshop features and we are starting to take a look at that, we don't have a lot of experience with that for now but the idea seeing what content you would create is so exciting!

In order to have a better idea of what you would like to do, we would love to hear from the creative modders out there to hear you and see what you would like to be able to do, in order to do that we have created an [url="https://discord.gg/hibernian-workshop"]event channel on our Discord server[/url] where you can suggest your ideas and upvote the others suggestions! 
There will be things we won't be able to do but we will try our best to take extra attention to what was upvoted the most.[/p][p][/p][h2]Animals Charity DLC[/h2][p][/p][p]If you follow our currently announced roadmap (we will need to update it at some point when we define more precisely what is next) our next update will be the Animals Charity DLC! 

This DLC has been inspired to us by the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1317160/Children_of_Morta_Paws_and_Claws/?curator_clanid=32989971"]Paws & Claws DLC[/url] from the great [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/330020/Children_of_Morta/"]Children of Morta[/url] and they announce of their DLC page that they collected more than 460 000 $ for their association to protect animals!

We love animals ourselves, you can see below some of the team cats member we shared on August 8th for the cat international day![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/cb8b85f59d853efef48c61f1e8c9d54522e6fcba.jpg"][/img]

We felt like this initiative was amazing and absolutely wanted to run a similar campaign to get money for animals Charity so we asked people of Dead Mage and they were happy we would follow their steps and try to gather money for charity too![/p][p]
We have checked different associations and we ended up having an excellent contact with [url="https://one-voice.fr/"]One Voice[/url] who are actively fighting for animals rights and protection internationally! 

In order to help them save animals, we are collaborating and [b]we will give them[/b] [b]100% of the revenue generated by this upcoming DLC[/b] so we hope it will work nicely to support them as much as possible ːzagplsː[/p][p][/p][p]About the game content itself, we already have a lot of ideas but we still need to finalize them. What we know is that we would rework the bottom right part of the hub to make a shelter for animals and the animals would be able to follow you during your runs and should provide different bonuses that should not be locked the animals themselves so you can select your favorite animal and your favorite bonus separately, here is a concept we worked on to pitch to One Voice - [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/11feed1d97c8c6b41a3e18116a9e56d28b6396e7.jpg"][/img]
We hope that weither it is for the gameplay part or for supporting the charity for animals this DLC will be making everyone happy!!

---

Before I go, I wanted to credit the tremendous work of the passionated community for the [url="https://astralascent.wiki.gg/"]Astral Ascent Wiki page[/url]!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/7a14800ff4dfc4d22ab97935fd1543cf7c9e7e3b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You can lean more about pretty much every aspect of the game with a ton of accurate details so don't hesitate to visit it! 

Wishing all of you an excellent day and great time in game!

- The Hibernian Workshop Team[/p]

notes.title: Update 2.1 is live now!
notes.notes:
[h1]Summer Barbecue Update![/h1][p][/p][p]Summer is already hot super hot in France we have used Barbecue's flames to cook you a surprise an update with a lot balancing and bug fixing! ːtaffyː[/p][p]
Take a look to the full Patch Notes below - 
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/523095184762733086"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We have fixed many bugs and balanced a lot of elements based on community feedback so we hope you will enjoy this new update to play during the summer![/p][p][/p][h1]Update 2.2 preview![/h1][p][/p][p]We are also already working hard on the version 2.2 including many assets to unlock and buy to customize your own hub, here are a few examples![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/99a7c84e4b7aec9967ab1d714b6ce83f03e679d7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/3071d5d914c9cbbcf546e1ad409c90672e67c9cb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/cb467766c02cee859b841ec3040ef2da886800fa.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/37277553ad446a9d8684f9e17fd08b5b4b1c574e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/669d058c689a08bf1a957b4e1d73c686a5c0efad.png"][/img][/p][p]You will have [b]dozens of specific assets to select[/b], that's a lot of graphical work with different themes such as Oasis, Steampunk and more, if you have suggestions for graphical themes, feel free to let us know on our [url="https://discord.gg/hibernian-workshop" style="button" buttoncolor="#37bafb"]Discord Server[/url] ![/p][p][/p][p]In addition to this update we also have a surprise for you with [b]new spells coming for the heroes[/b] in this 2.2 version! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/d9db2802d1f53eb6d0f6eb83c1893e66c8f0709e.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/b50c16b916b71d73a94ac14f8590ff8f26c5454f.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/0811164a97c6ce26619355dc633ffee2042a4582.gif"][/img]
And we have listened to the community once again, the most upvoted request is that Yamat gets more spells as she has less than the others so we will add more spells to Yamat than to the other heroes for this update! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/3e3aeb38588cd9fe889c6212ff25d52a092e0e8d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Same than for the environments, don't hesitate to come over our  [url="https://discord.gg/hibernian-workshop" style="button"]Discord Server[/url] to give your suggestions![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]New playable Hero![/h1][p][/p][p]Don't forget Arven the new playable hero for Astral Ascent from our next game  [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3276270/Fallen_Fates/" buttoncolor="#fb3737"]Fallen Fates[/url] coming to Kickstarter on September![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/a11cfb962bd79c5269a0f35249c3355e71aafdc0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Once again it is super appreciated if you take a look at our upcoming campaign, if you want to support us, [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hibernian-workshop/fallen-fates" style="button" buttoncolor="#08770a"]follow the Kickstarter Campaign[/url] !! [/p][p]And you can even gain physical rewards by doing so by joining the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/506205420110479675" style="button"]Celebration Giveaway[/url]! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/d027b26dc7f46d361970ac3b88bfd0b049a4088d.png"][/img]

We are still going to update Astral Ascent frequently, don't worry about that!  [/p][p]Wishing you the best summer and see you soon for the 2.2 update!

- The Hibernian Workshop Team[/p][p][/p]

Today is the day, exactly 4 years ago we finished our Kickstarter Campaign for Astral Ascent and[b] today, after 6 months of work (we nearly doubled the game content, it takes time!), we finally release the 2.0 Update: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3372880/Astral_Ascent__The_Outer_Reaches/]The Outer Reaches[/url][/b] which is by far the biggest update to the game so far, here is [b]the trailer!
[/b]
[previewyoutube=2UI6MOrUBEk;full][/previewyoutube]
We are happy we were able to support the game with so many updates and that was made possible because all of you are supporting and talking about the game! 

To celebrate, the game will hit [b]its biggest promotion to date of 50% off for 2 weeks[/b] starting at 7PM CET today!

We're self-published and every share and review has helped so much. Thank you for your continued support!ːzagplsː

If you want more detailed informations you can check the detailed [b]Pach Notes[/b] below!
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/523090111361974309
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/0824bf2b0c54596ee47491b7ec8a38faeb4e6a0e.gif[/img]

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3372880/Astral_Ascent__The_Outer_Reaches/]DLC [/url]New Content[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3372880/Astral_Ascent__The_Outer_Reaches/


[h2]4 New Worlds[/h2]
Ophiuchus conquered new worlds and added them to his collection and you can now go through [b]The Outer Reaches[/b] worlds!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/19a24381a3dc3ee8f309780ccd395d6e3ab6e8d4.png[/img]
Explore these new worlds for a new experience!

[list][*][b]Shattered Rises[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/b8d3f786a39fbc3b4b8e8fd0325544611c3bbd78.jpg[/img]
[quote=autor]They said hiking is good for the cardio, but it’s really high up here.[/quote]

[*][b]Molten Wastes[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/a9762139dce2c927fb66e7e4ff593b44418b6167.jpg[/img]
[quote=autor]You like the heat, but your soles are melting.[/quote]

[*][b]Frostbound Expanses[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/481df455ca4cd92444dea43ddf3688bb8450a3dd.jpg[/img]
[quote=autor]You love snow, but you'd better keep moving if you want to keep your finger alive. [/quote]

[*][b]Obsidian Heights[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/c505b250b307e9bc4687bec6ba2bd5834bf6aaa0.jpg[/img]
[quote=autor]You like fog but care of what it hides from you. [/quote]
[/list]
Each new world has a total of [b]8 new enemies[/b] and [b]4 traps[/b] for a total of [b]32 new Enemies[/b] and [b]16 new traps[/b]! 
This is doubling the content related to these elements making runs much more interesting, we also made sure to give an incentive to select one world over another one during the run which is explained below in the section dedicated to the new special rooms!
Each new world also comes with [b]a new music[/b] from Dale North! The new musics are more rhythmed for dynamic exploration!

[h2]Andromeda Boss Fight[/h2]
Andromeda had enough of hiding and wants to join the battle for freedom!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/4ea8a50571d7cf83fd6550550b311a45a6d33d3e.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Defy Andromeda in an epic duel![/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/1e0553d0fac8de9b59670de40a8efe3e641270aa.jpg[/img]
Once per run, you can [b]defy Andromeda[/b] in her bar, she wants to see if you have what it takes at your full potential so she will be giving you max life, max mana and a fullfil your healing shards for the fight. [list]
[*] If you fail she will simply set your life mana and healing shards as they were being defying her, so feel free to defy her at each run, you have nothing to lose, this fight is always a quick win or a quick defeat!
[*] If you win she will grant you [b]her super drink[/b] giving 1 drink of each type and join you as a summon for the rest of your run[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/a45ce97482a59f0233d83617572a79bc12f9bf53.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Andromeda summon[/b]
Andromeda summon is not replacing Zodiac Summons but it's an addition named [b]Zantetsuken[/b] that will automatically finish Star Guardians and Zodiacs when their health reach 15%.
[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcTR2bHZldm52bnBxNXRnMGFvdnp5MjVvcHhlYnEyZGFqcWdrdTl4bCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/OFS3KDAbcRthdF7njW/giphy.gif[/img]
It's so satisfying to have such a powerful ally by your side!

[*] [b]Andromeda Ending[/b]
You will also be able to get Andromeda's narrative ending if you escape the prison with Andromeda by your side![/list]
Andromeda also comes [b]with a lot of new lines fully voiced in English and Japanese[/b]!

[h1]Free Update New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]New Imprint system - 90 ways to improve your spells![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/0ba58f052e0060a47f6570697877a21d704343a2.jpg[/img]
The Imprint system is probably the biggest addition to the game runs coming with this Update 2.0! We wanted to add a new currency for exploration rooms to have more choices than : Quartz / Gambits / Auras making it more interesting to select rooms. We also wanted to make spells, supposed to be the core of the game, more central in the experience and more interesting! Finally, we wanted to shake a little the currency synergy system consisting of stacking things looking alike to be powerful, the imprints system requires more flexibility to create powerful combos!
[list]
[*] [b]New Loot in Exploration Room[/b]
One more loot type in exploration rooms dilutes the existing room types, it makes all rewards overall a little less common and more valuable to get. For example getting a little bit less Gambits will make Cetus room and Sun Room more interesting and getting a little bit less Auras will make the Yalee Kingdom and the New Aura Room more interesting! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/80a46ee310d5a44fa459ea95f916e131bdc1ee82.jpg[/img]
You can loot up to 8 imprints per run and you loot them 2 at a time in Exploration rooms, we wanted this to not be too overwhelming by having too many elements to read and compare. You can only equip one of the 2 imprints but all imprints will automatically go to the Imprint Infuser at Andromeda's Bar and Imprints you find during your runs can be freely equiped and removed from your spells at the dedicated UI in Andromeda's Bar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/b07eadc9155ce9c0e9df9074aa34ee2429ab671b.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]90 Blueprints to collect![/b]
The 90 new Imprints are linked to Blueprints you will have to find during your runs through the game! You can find them by defeating Zodiacs bosses, Star Guardians and Elite enemies!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/e02aae1ccf71d803c5df81a4c5045e8a33455402.jpg[/img]
You can see all of your collect imprints in the [b]Imprints Archive[/b] at [b]Andromeda's Bar[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/c44ba2b66e29ed9f2c0d08f9dba42502b442315f.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Synergy and Transcendance[/b]
Some Imprints can have an effect no matter your spell like the first condition below
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/5770bf9d9cc798a77b4fbb9db3566b38c36a63fe.jpg[/img]

Some other have requirements to work even for their first effects like below
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/0e8c9c8fca7f09780353a4b61711839a2baaed79.jpg[/img]
In both cases you will have [b]Transcendance Effect [/b]giving extra power ups if you meet specific requirements. Sometimes you will already have the right elements and sometimes you will need to work on them to have the effect and the Transcendance activated. As I said earlier, this is changing a bit the habits of focusing only on one affinity, one spell type as some imprints can be of a different affinity than your main one but still super useful or powerful, so make sure to think about that while making your builds!

[*] [b]Powerful combos[/b]
You can create a lot of fun and powerful combos, you can see some examples below, you have 90 of them to experiment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/1c4907fb291b5d5a386c5e17b3d293bba3f0e090.jpg[/img]
[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYmtmcDF3NW1rdjA2MmhpOWtvZ3M0NDlvbGhuMGE3d3V0ZDN2OHk0MSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/IFF3X5V5DQb0W2rFLE/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/05b2310458bbe7081579dcb4eeaba28ced75b0ee.jpg[/img]
[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExOXlwbDMyamQ0emJ5cXZ0NzB5Y3o4MXNueWN1b3FsMzk3dWNka2QzcCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/8spMZBSOXnLEa8NgAS/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/73484b483ce9e13093efc83f37686e77629fe797.jpg[/img]
[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExaHQxcmsxdmg5OXl5bG11anM4M3gydzN5N2ZkbDFjY2JxNXlvc2F3ayZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/TsmKZw3Rw0oAff2hkH/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/7aedf1d9a3ea59ee6e1289163bf12a223a9e1600.jpg[/img]
[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNmljNm5rZTc1ajFoYTUydDUzcjkydG1qc3k5eHVheDhibWwybTVndCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/Wjjc2NmwngTkDyTZBf/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/064c7dc862e82ccc69103ddee9b0623b9ed48ba5.jpg[/img]
[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZ3JzazJ2c2M0ODZ0enJza3U5OGt0dTlzbW85dWQ1a2hudmoyODhnNyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/Y8iQCmWz1EyJDbxfBQ/giphy.gif[/img]

[/list]
[*] [b]New Intro Room[/b]
We thought the previous introduction room was too stacked and overwhelming, we decided to create a new one allowing to separate better the start of runs bonuses from the classical world intro rooms.
It also makes it clearer and easier to select in which world you will start your run (classical or The Outer Reaches version).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/cfa3cb1835fda75fa0eea2c2923178070c01dd97.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]New Special Rooms[/b]
2 times per world, a choice will be attached to world selection, one time it will be a selection among existing special rooms (Cetus, Pavo, etc.) so one biome will have one special room and the other biome a different one, they appear organically (next to Exploration/Fight Rooms) during the world so they are an additional speical room. Another time, it will be among the New Auras Room and New Echo Room (explained below), even if they are guaranteed it will cost you 5. These 2 choices are guaranteed in every run making the biome selection more interesting depending on the reward you want.
[list][*] [b]New Aura Room[/b]
This new room allows you to pick any existing Aura at a Mythic or Astral rarity level, this room is the best choice to complete a build you are making. It should make powerful builds much more frequent and reliable than before!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/1e2605a547cc514db8007ec22d2ac86b4472e5c2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/ebe21e82a37a0274f5a8e44cdf44125b9a1a35ed.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]New Echo Room[/b]
This new room allows you to pick any existing Echo to have the best synergies or to have the support Echo you need for your run! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/82dd4605574382104910fe820cc0c6f26b545b53.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/604a4b4a3598a050aadd89cb9f725bf841192d31.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[*] [b]Better Impacts[/b]
A feedback we received multiple times was the lack of powerful impact feeling with basic attacks so we added new impacts for all weapons giving much better sensations!
We have also added extra vertical bumps on enemies so the hits feel more impactful.
[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbXg1YTkwc3RmOGpha2Fra2x1anQwbjFxeHc4amRkdnp0dXgwcDV5eSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/GhdPldiAVdz6RUY0T4/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNTh1MWVtMTRjZDEzYjU5YndyazF6MGI1cmZ0YWF6MG80ejVnZ2hvcCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/dnslAg6uYQhhjWXqSQ/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Tons of QoL[/b]
[list]
[*] In the Yalee Kingdom, the Camera is now centered so you can see all the Auras at once without needing to go on auras one by one like before and the Reset Yalee is now at the center to walk less to reset the choices
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/e9df6b0f2dcfb6e59e8ab1a5ddcb702217ffe2c8.jpg[/img]
[*] In the Echo Island, the camera is now centered so you see all auras at once with no need to move to check them and icons above heads show you what they do so you do not need to check them one by one
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/e040eeb5eef9c2456fe86010c2bc4e36edac23b2.jpg[/img]
[*] Selecting the drinks at Andromeda's Bar could be very slow, even more if you had a lot of stars on you, now it's much faster making it more fluid
[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExajc2aTBuYXBuOW5wcnM2aTcxdnFnZWx6cHJ2Mnh1ZzI1bW8zeWVycCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/g1gqfhxkjpkGfWGKJt/giphy.gif[/img]
[*] Some rooms are now shorter like Intro rooms, Zodiac Rooms and Star Guardian rooms, they needed to walk too much to get to the next room
[*] Transitions between rooms is now faster making it smoother to go through rooms
[*] Teleport rails in Event Horizon is also faster
[*] The UI windows are clearer for loots
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/8f8f5bdd74e4d9f15bf645dc50757f9350b19a5a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/e631b32e87ef1a71b652a7cc05bfbcc088c37f70.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/4a1c11fcaf5d7fd8e1ca0d17326ff2185d08ecfd.jpg[/img]
[*] You can now buy with Sun Pieces (if you already defeated DL6+) the Zodiac Summons, this is made for experienced players who already did the challenges many many times and have extra sun pieces to use!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/db5323a47c30b1c6a3c3a06910e15750ba6d7ed4.jpg[/img]
[/list]
We have globally tried to improve a lot of small frictions we could find to make the overall experience more enjoyable!

[*] [b]Tons of Balancing[/b]
We have made a lot of balancing on Auras, Spells, Weapons Passive that people mentioned being too weak and you can find all of that in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/523090111361974309]2.0 Patch Notes[/url].
We have also made an important change to the Cursed Telescope, we only kept the Astral rarity for effects but we made maluses more important. We think this makes this room much more interesting and the bonuses full to play with!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/51db6411c4d8e10c9d064a00470c518bfe1781db.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h1]New Roadmap[/h1]
We are super happy to announce that thanks to the support we received until now, we are able to commit on more updates for Astral Ascent and that's a great news because we still have a tons of things in mind to make the game better and funnier to play!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/f86686a1db8a4f45a18e7fd1fabfada773b97300.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Customization System for the Hub[/b]
Following a suggestion event (about what to do with the Extra Sun Pieces) on our [url=http://discord.gg/hibernian-workshop]Discord Server[/url], the most voted choice was being able to Custom the hub with the Extra Sun Pieces. We are working on many different collections for you to buy and make this place truly yours! Here is an example below with the Coral/Seaside collection!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/4f0e4cbcc87bcfb46d29f1e41f8fae19b7d6fd82.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/4e41a7088acbceb81896560b29a687eead47edc9.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Charity Pet DLC[/b]
We found very inspiring the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1317160/Children_of_Morta_Paws_and_Claws/?curator_clanid=32989971]Paws and Claws[/url] DLC from Children of Morta to collect money for Charity for animals, they already collected more than $460 000 for the [url=https://donate.humaneworld.org/page/160655/donate/1?ea.tracking.id=ad_gg_non_core_countries_brand_hsi&utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_term=international%20humane%20society&en_txn10=ad_gg_cpc_1661572967_171460847261_732078157901_international%20humane%20society&en_og_source=ad_gg_fndr_160655_hwfa&gad_source=5&gad_campaignid=1661572967&gclid=EAIaIQobChMI2OvH8ev_jAMVxbVoCR1SJjOJEAAYASAAEgJaq_D_BwE]Humane Society International charity[/url]. That's also a cause close to our hearts at Hibernian Workshop and we asked Dead Mage if they would be fine for us to follow their lead and create a similar initiative on our side for Astral Ascent and they were absolutely fine for that so we are completely going to do that! Like for Paws And Claws DLC, [b]100% of the benefice will go to Charity[/b]!

[*] [b]Boss Rush[/b]
We have the Boss Rush in mind for a very long time, it was supposed to be the first update post 1.0 release. It just makes so much sense for Astral Ascent to have a Boss Rush given how many bosses we have 
[/list]

[h1]Collector Physical editions[/h1]
Taking the occasion to speak again about the beautiful Collector Editions including Yamat DLC and The Outer Reaches DLC available for preorder coming from [url=https://www.redartgames.com/]Red Art Games[/url], for [b]PS5 and Nintendo Switch[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/34766dce6346df0bf1f3912c77b938f875bbc983.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/a8205b6a708f07705cf8cf96e9f55ea65e520605.jpg[/img]
The [url=https://www.redartgames.com/search?controller=search&s=astral+ascent]DELUXE edition[/url] contains: 
[list][*]Base Game
[*]DLC 1 : Yamat, the breach Traveler

[*]1 acrylic stand
[/list]
The [url=https://www.redartgames.com/search?controller=search&s=astral+ascent]COLLECTOR edition[/url] contains: 
[list][*]Same as DELUXE Edition
[*]Steelcase
[*]Double-sided Poster
[*]OST
[/list]

These are coming in limited editions for each platforms!

[h1]Updated OST[/h1]
We will soon update the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455290/Astral_Ascent_Original_Game_Soundtrack/]OST of the game[/url] as new musics were introduced for the 1.7 and the 2.0 for a total of 7 new musics and 37 tracks in total!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/3435e94fcd7986ab0115f7131b368326ed3b4a8a.jpg[/img]
So stay tuned for that!

[h1]Big Surprise Coming Soon![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/0041c5507eb214bb2fc0070b5ef1541f3aca7764.png[/img]
Well, 2025 might be full of surprises from our studio and [b]you might not want to miss what we will announce end of May[/b], so be sure to follow us on your favorite social media!

notes.title: Patch Notes - April 2025 - 2.0.3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/6242ded5473885a37513cb08a5f0e84b1dacae9e.gif[/img]

⭐[i][b]Changes inspired by our community![/b][/i]

[h2]Major Features[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]New Alternative Worlds (Paid DLC): [/b]4 new worlds to explore 
5 new musical tracks
16 new traps and elements
32 new enemies
[hr][/hr][*][b]Andromeda's Return (Paid DLC): [/b]Experience an exciting new battle
Earn Andromeda's respect and the ability to summon her
Witness Andromeda's Ending
[hr][/hr][*][b]New Intro Room: [/b]The First Room is now separated in 2 rooms to have a less overwhelming experience
[hr][/hr][*][b]The Void Imprints: [/b]- New reward loot in exploration rooms, featuring 90 unique imprints
- A way to improve your spells with unique activations
- Players start with 25 different imprints, the rest are unlocked by finding Blueprints during runs
- A new interface in Andromeda's bar to reuse the imprints you looted
[hr][/hr][*][b]Bonus Room System: [/b]Added New system to world selection, which adds a bonus room to the world twice during a run.
[hr][/hr][*][b]New Rooms: [/b]Added Aura selection room, which allows the selection of an aura
[hr][/hr][*][b]New Rooms : [/b]Added Echo selection room, which allows the selection of any echo
[/list]
[h2]Small Features[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]In Event Horizon you now move faster using the rail between islands
[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ Transitions between rooms in now faster when entering a portal
[hr][/hr][*]New visual FX for each weapon when hitting the enemies
[hr][/hr][*]Enemies are now bumped up when hit by weapons
[hr][/hr][*]Some enemies are now bumped higher when hit by upward attacks
[hr][/hr][*]The Small Dragon now triggers automatically to give your Auras faster
[hr][/hr][*]Slimes were not impacted by the Opacity effect
[hr][/hr][*][b]Yalee Kingdom: [/b]Yalee's reset is now located high up on a platform and the camera zooms out to get a direct view of all auras.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Echo Island: [/b]Echo Island now shows all echoes at once and icons above Echoes help seeing what the echoes are about without needing to check them.
[hr][/hr][*]The Zodiac Challenge Chest for Summons can be purchased with Sun Pieces from Destiny Level 6+
[hr][/hr][*]Intro and boss rooms are shorter
[hr][/hr][*]New interface for Gambit loot, slot unlocker and Pavo feathers
[hr][/hr][*]Portal to next rooms are now closer in The Void and The Reckless Void
[hr][/hr][*]Ghost Enemies from Destiny Level modifiers are removed upon room or Zodiac Fight completion.
[hr][/hr][*]Added Jump Crystals in the Cursed Telescope room and it's also a little smaller now
[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ Andromeda's Bar changes
- Andromeda's bar for drinks has is now higher to always see the drinks
- Drinks reappear much faster
- Drinks distance of interaction is bigger now

- Visual Effects have been reduced
[hr][/hr][*]Chamaeleon was misplaced in World 4 boss fight room and missing in World 3 boss fight room - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 2.0.2[/b][/i]
[/list]
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ The cursed telescope now only has astral rarity bonuses (all other rarities have been removed).
To compensate, penalties are more dangerous.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Auras: [/b]Unique Tag Context: Due to the increased availability of duplicate Astral Auras, a number of Auras have received the ""Unique"" tag if it was determined that stacking these could be stronger than intended. 


Carve Mastery 
On critical hit, creates 1 Ice Idol: reduction of the cd from 5 to 3 seconds
Increases critical hit chances: Increased critical chance from 10% to 15%

Spark Conductor
Spark bounces an additional time: unique tag added (No change in functionality, it always worked this way)

Boots Of The Herlad
On lightning orb hit, 25% chances to create 1 spark: unique tag added

Warchief Bracers
On spell refresh, restores 2 mana: unique tag added

Sword Of The Warrior
Increases strength: Damage increased from 20% to 30%
Increases attack speed: Attack speed increased from 20% to 25%
Increases critical hit chance: Critical hit chance increased from 15 to 20%

Twin Calibur
On spirit sword, creates 2 missiles: unique tag added

Fire Propellant
Massively increases combustion size unique tag added (No change in functionality, it always worked this way)

Raw Force
Increased combustion damage from 75 to 100%

Absolute Zero
Increased Frostbite damage from 50 to 75%

Prowess Of The Sky
When hero it hit, gains a random bonus effect for 5 seconds: Reduction of cd from 12 to 5 seconds
When gaining a bonus effect, create 5 thunder strike: Reduction in the number of thunder strikes created from 5 to 4

Rustling Fall
On fall attack, creates 4 ice fragment: reduction of the cd from 10 to 6 seconds

Polar Venom
Added a new effect: Increases poison limit by 5

Balance Master

Blade Storm
When dashing through enemies, casts slashing squall: Reduction of cd from 7 to 4 seconds

Homing Embers

Incandescent Rain
Increases combustion damage from 50 to 60%

Blinding comets
Increases combustion damage from 50 to 60%

notes.title: 2.0 update - Mark the date!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! ːzimzimSmileː

We are coming to show you a bit more elements of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3372880/Astral_Ascent__The_Outer_Reaches/][b]2.0 Update - The Outer Reaches[/b][/url] update and DLC, first of all thanks so much for being already [b]more than 10.000[/b] to have wishlisted this new DLC ! ːbarbecuePogː

Wishlisting it helps us with visibility on Steam and you will of course receive a notification once it's out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3372880/Astral_Ascent__The_Outer_Reaches/

[h2]Andromeda is getting ready[/h2]
Andromeda fight is almost ready and she will be [b]brutal[/b]! We want this duel to be either a quick win or quick defeat, you've been warned! 

[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExb2FwajExcnp0bjNlczQwbDE5N2N4Y202OHZhc3JkYnJwcDgxcjVqMSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/UT8pkbpkaNY9g9BXYO/giphy.gif[/img]
(but no worries she just wants to see if you are worthy or not, she wont stop your runs)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/b2284c7a604551e9e71fc79c4f1156322439dc16.jpg[/img]


[h2]New system for spells[/h2]
We have been working on the new system related to spells named "Void Imprints", it is going to be a [b]new loot type in Exploration rooms[/b] (in addition to Gambits, Quartz and Auras) giving more variety to the choice of rooms. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/59cc5e3f1240b15bd3ee541b520e78ed7d707c85.png[/img]
You can equip one directly on a spell but every one you found (even if not equiped) during your run are available at Andromeda's bar to equip during your run.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/cfdc4b3751ac679be434222459fb50decb93bbc0.gif[/img]
There are Void Imprints for each affinity for a total of more than [b]90 unique imprints[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/0e654c43f95db7bc010dd553024d5cf528d75b41.png[/img]
Here is one example per affinity -
[quote=author][list]
[*]On spell cast, create an Incandescent barrier for 10 seconds, create 1 combustion if the enemy hits you
[i][b]Transcendence effect:[/b][/i]If the spell is lvl 10+, gain Shield for 3 second and attract 3 enemies

[*]The first enemy hit by this spell creates a frozen ground for 6 seconds applying 1 freeze periodically
[i][b]Transcendence effect:[/b][/i]For each freeze gambit equipped on this spell, adds 1 second to the duration 

[*]On spell cast, 2 enemies are marked by a curse mark for 7 seconds, dealing damage when the affected enemies attack
[i][b]Transcendence effect:[/b][/i]If the spell is full poison affinity, adds 1 curse mark on another enemy

[*]The first enemy hit by this spell creates a column of lightning for 5 seconds, pushing back enemies and apply 1 electrify on hit
[i][b]Transcendence effect:[/b][/i]If the spell is full electric affinity, passing through column of lightning grants thunder dash for 5 seconds

[*]The first enemy hit by this spell attracts up to 4 enemies
[i][b]Transcendence effect:[/b][/i]If the spell is full neutral affinity, increase damage on this spell by 30%
[/list][/quote]
This new system is made to make spells more interesting to use and build and overall more impactful and strategic to use!

[h2]New Intro room[/h2]
One new change is that we decided to add a new room before the first intro room when starting a run and there are several reasons for that
[quote=author][list]
[*] First Room was too stacked with too many things to do at once
[*] First Intro Room was very different from the other intro rooms from worlds 2, 3, 4
[*] We needed to be able to select default world or The Outer Reaches variation before entering the world
[*] Elements were badly placed with the Baby Dragon being on the left of spawn for example
[/list] [/quote]
This has also allowed us to add the portal to buy the DLC there instead of adding even more elements in the main hub, we will have more possibilities if we want to add more features there!
[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExaDJjMGV2cHIzMWRhYjNpcDR0ZmI2MjBtZTlydDQzNDI2MmxmNTJubiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/su5CkMsptlCHsIWkKC/giphy.gif[/img]

We decided to make of this new room a calm and neutral place!
[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYjhhM3J4c3BzaHMzc2JlNTl5ajBub29ucjd1YmIyZm5haHhiZWRjNiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/BEV0o1Q1A0MUVpJW9Q/giphy.gif[/img]



[h2]More Improvements[/h2]
In addition to all the content planned, (not everything is shown there as its missing the 4 new worlds, 32 new enemies, 16 new traps) we are also taking time to improve things all around the game. One feedback we often received was the lack of impact feeling when doing basic attacks, we have made a new impact FX per weapon/per character (so 20 different FX) and improved the hit feeling.
[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExb3VqbHFjbWczYWo5bWV4OWV4Ynd3b2lrejBuZmhzM3pjMDlvMnNkaCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/fF2uTbZUrP4hfDtam6/giphy.gif[/img]

We have also speed up many slow interactions like picking up the drinks at Andromeda's
[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZzRyZHBhd3NocmJwZTU4czgxNjhrNjRhc2twaDlsejl4ZHg0bjQzeiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/GDS1AQg3zU9840b7iD/giphy.gif[/img]
We have also speed up entering end of rooms portals, reset start auras, we even reduced the size of some rooms to make runs more fluid and smooth to go through!


[h2]New physical edition[/h2]
We are also super happy to announce that we will be partnering with [url=https://www.redartgames.com/][b]Red Are Games[/b][/url] open pre-orders for new [b]physical editions[/b] including [b]steelcase[/b] and other elements!

Long story short, the 2.0 Update will be a massive change for the game and we hope you are as excited as we are for it! 

We are still keeping more secrets coming for 2025 so stay tuned and don't hesitate to follow us on

[/list]

Have an excellent week ahead and [b]mark the date for April 30[/b] ! ːzagplsː

This 1.10 update content is smaller than usual because we are hard working on the 2.0 update!

The update is planned for [b]April 30 2025[/b] and we still have a lot to do! The amount of content is very big as we wish for it to deliver a new and fresh experience for Astral Ascent at this moment.

We have already been working on the new Rooms. One of them is allowing you to pick any Auras from the game, Auras are ordered by key words so if you have Fire Slime like in the example below, they will be in the Fire and in the Slime categories.
[previewyoutube=oYmRqwhvctk;full][/previewyoutube]
The idea is that you simply go to the category you are focusing right now, for example Ice Swords and you will see all auras related to Ice Swords at once.

We have also worked on the Room to select any Echoes from the game, with 40 Echoes in the game it makes sure you can get the exact Echo you want to complete your build as we want to make sure all echoes exist for their respective builds.
[previewyoutube=9DdoQ2mLxLM;full][/previewyoutube]

We have also started to work on the [b]Andromeda's boss fight [/b]and we found out how she will fight and how this fight will be integrated in the game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/3f23e7e1cf0c2fdcf1b9718b68029e8d3f190208.png[/img]

Don't hesitate to [b]wishlist the DLC[/b] if you want to!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3372880/Astral_Ascent__The_Outer_Reaches/


[h2]Steam Couch Co-op Fest[/h2]
Finally, we are part of the [b]Steam Couch Co-op Fest[/b] so it's a great opportunity to remind you can play in co-op in Astral Ascent, either in local co-op or through Remote Play Together or Parsec for online play!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/b8a46ef12c28229fb8dc9c72185500e32ef74bca.jpg[/img]

We wish you all to have an amazing week ahead and we cannot to tell you more about the Outer Reaches and other surprises coming this year!

-The Hibernian Workshop Team

[hr] [/hr]
[h2]Weapons Improvements[/h2]
[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/ef716734c98933320710ff02a092146a7fbead38.gif[/img]

This also changes a lot of things for [b]Weapon Passives[/b] as you can have both passives at once but you need the right weapon to use them. For example if you get stacks for your weapon when killing enemies, you can kill them with your other weapon and still get the stacks but you will need to switch to the right weapon to consume them!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3372880/Astral_Ascent__The_Outer_Reaches

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/20f927b5411e1d900bba539e348153b17c8106bb.jpg[/img]

[quote=author][i]The Master destroyed countless worlds for his selfish collection. The Fragments Plains, The Red Barrens, The Coral Archipelago and The Crimson Highlands.  Quoted text 
You go through these worlds to reach The Master because it is the easiest way to reach him but there are many other worlds, alternative paths to follow, The Outer Reaches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/5332e331b323787c3ca5422ed681d0c73a6d90b2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/7bd668f97f7a21a3c768c2a31bfee1be6db78af6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/e5ea015cc52645276154d97cdb4c07efd42ecb9d.png[/img]

notes.title: Astral Ascent x Dead Cells update announcement
notes.notes:
We are very excited to announce to you our collaboration with Motion Twin to release a [b]Dead Cells update for Astral Ascent coming out on November 27th[/b]! Here is our reveal teaser below! ːbarbecuePogː

[previewyoutube=GYnAX_EZEIQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We are very proud of this collaboration as Dead Cells is the most popular of our genre of Platformer Roguelike games it is probably the game that defined this genre the most. It is also a game we took inspiration from for its fluidity of movement and nervous action.

If you do not own Dead Cells already, you can now purchase it alongside Astral Ascent in a bundle!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46767/Dead_Cells__Astral_Ascent_Duo/

They have also released a [url=https://deadcellstheboardgame.com/]Board Game[/url] just recently and their great [url=https://youtu.be/B3gdVvAu0fo]Animated Serie[/url] started release in English! And of course they recently launched their new game Windblown we have a ton of fun playing in co-op!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1911610/Windblown/

Though you may want to wait November 27th for an extra discount for the launch of the update.

[h1]What to expect from this update?[/h1]

You will be able to play with 5 unique weapons from Dead Cells : 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/b347952c4232885a3ce9611a358c2e7cbf661752.gif[/img]
[list][*] [b]Nutcracker[/b] for Kiran
[*] [b]Throwing Knives[/b] for Ayla
[*] [b]Wrenching Whip[/b] for Octave
[*] [b]Scythe Claw[/b] for Calie
[*] [b]Symmetrical Lance[/b] for Yamat
[/list]
These weapons will also come with 15 new passives.
[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExN3Rpcnl2ZXlvOHh4OTR0NGJ2cmtpYnljcjVrMG14OGg5eXgwZ2ZnaCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/6ob52Ld6771N8zoFYW/giphy.gif[/img]

We are also introducing a new system in the 1.9 update, you will be able to hold 2 weapons at once, giving you more strategy opportunities and poweful combos with weapon passives!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/09e51889063b8da7f871ff05591eca106a1a0892.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/c568ba4f7e461d9c8147ce8e9873cc0ec69d7e55.gif[/img]
It will of course be possible to unlock both of weapons equipped passives at once!

A new addition is also that weapons will always be visible when playing the game now!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/5edacdfad7898f840afd720692890f3ff0acac92.gif[/img]
It was a lot of work so we hope you will enjoy this change! It is also the case for big weapons like Octave's rocket launcher!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/c9a247e3024edaa5a44413f24b63dcaaab3cbe33.jpg[/img]

We didn't show anything from 1.9 before today but we will be able to share more on our Discord Server and Twitter of what is coming in just 2 weeks from now 

We hope you will keep supporting us in this journey to become one of the best action roguelite out there ːzagplsː

Have an excellent week everyone! ːzimzimSmileː

- The Hibernian Workshop Team

notes.title: Cursed Telescope Room, Builds Recap and QoL !
notes.notes:
First of all, thanks for the great reception of the 1.7 version! We are working hard on new updates!

[h2]Version 1.8 complete Patch-Notes:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/4545912358018084589

[h1]Cursed Telescope[/h1]
The first major change of this new version is the [b]rework of the hub Telescope[/b]. We [b]removed all the perks that were linked to a specific build[/b] because you would select them in the hub before knowing what would be your build during the run so it would either be frustrating because you do not find the right build or not be useful if you don't do this build so we focused on perks working with all builds. We also [b]added new perks in the hub[/b].

Adding to that, we have created a [b]new room type : The Cursed Telescope[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/c24c7347a2729b5259e1a0b022ede9d8ae204070.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/21247aad0c56d8df959a4e36cea78d5354793ea9.jpg[/img]

This new room can be found [b]up to 2 times per run[/b] and will allow you to [b]get new Telescope perks[/b], different from the Hub ones, with usual rarities : common, rare, mythic and astral.
But a random Malus is attached to each of these bonus and will be removed when reaching Andromeda's bar of your current world.
[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbGtjcGQwbHkwOGVyZmtkaTM0MTlsdjczeDVjM2lqN2tnNjYwc211MSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/NKc78DMoDlzV8PjYa8/giphy.gif[/img]
That's a total of [b]31 bonuses there (102 with rarities) and 15 maluses in this new room[/b]. This room works very similar to Chaos in Hades, high risk high rewards! ːzagplsː
To help you find what you want, we added [b]up to 6 rerolls[/b] you can get from a new Zim-Zim upgrade - 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/8b7362fefbced5cb6e54fd65f77be499cdd18d2b.jpg[/img]


[h1]Builds Recap[/h1]
A new feature is also the [b]Build Recap[/b], we used to see community members share their builds through a dozen of screens taken before the final boss and it felt really bad to share a good build. We have came with a solution to that - [b]the Prison Memento[/b]! In the hub you will be able to find this large book in the bottom right, if you open it it will show your runs (only the ones post 1.8 release).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/0b341af30d0868c3f9098e0a1e098f3fe8a18027.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/ec587544c5135a9efc6f42b10c2b357450848bde.jpg[/img]

This screen also appears when you Win a run or die and it also works in co-op (only from hub for now)!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/b10d91976a5afd4608f8ba9f1907ec929c99397c.jpg[/img]
We truly hope this will make [b]sharing your best runs and best builds easier[/b]!

[h1]QoL elements![/h1]
We have also improved a lot of small elements requested by the community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/6c2f311183634f89d4cde0722521b50b2025cd71.jpg[/img]
You can now preview on the progress bar where are the special rooms, the bar and the Zodiac fight, it does not display all the random rooms like Moon/Sun for example but it gives a better idea of what is coming next to help organize your run better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/a29fc00dd80843c4fd58e828835f2eb9dffebe40.jpg[/img]
An icon now shows what is the effect of the Zodiac summon before entering the room so you have a better idea if it will fit into your build or not.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/0865c54ed5e04694700c84f57966e024ba67de4f.gif[/img]
We have added a new system to reward players perfecting rooms, perfected rooms can stack and offer different rewards 
[list]
[*]Explo / Fight rooms - [b]1 Star[/b]
[*]Star Guardians - [b]2 Stars[/b]
[*]Zodiacs - [b]3 Stars[/b]
[/list]
And this stacks over room so the more rooms you perfect in a row the more stars you get in each new room and it resets when getting hit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/4774944efbca04afc8c815bea79aa8299c5c66fc.jpg[/img]
It has been requested a lot and the Arsenal is now available in the hub and in Andromeda's bar so you can change your weapon/passive before the boss if you want to!

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMjhsbzN0eGRxaG5ncXYzeTkxanVzMW9yMzUyZ2QwNTRnMGpmcGQ4MSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/BJN0lqGU00oIIbbGTb/giphy.gif[/img]
Another change is also that salvaging an Aura Refiner will give rarer Auras depending of your current world if you have Barbecue's aura.

There are more small changes like a 5th Aura Refiner in Event Horizon, double rewards in Cetus room in co-op and more!

[h1]2.0 is not the end![/h1]
We had also like to address a global concern we started to hear, [b]the 2.0 planned for Q1 2025 with new worlds is not the end of our updates for Astral Ascent[/b], we have more updates planned after that, some of them are already in the work ːzimzimSmileː

We do not tease the 1.9 version (big collab with a famous game) yet because we are still looking for opportunities to maybe announce it  in some places to get more visibility but it's progressing very well on our side and we cannot wait to show you more about this update coming very soon! (Q4 2024)!

Last thing, our friends at Doom Turtle just released a massive DLC + free update for their game Ember Knights in a few hours, this update is huge, don't hesitate to check it here - 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948140/Ember_Knights__Wrath_of_the_Architect/

Have an excellent time in the game and a great week ːzimzimSmileː

Louis

notes.notes:
[h1]Astral Ascent X Scourgebringer X Ember Knights X Spiritfall[/h1]

[previewyoutube=-EIvpIh_vGw;full][/previewyoutube]

We have teamed-up with Roguelites we love for this new update, bringing -
[list]

[*][b]Praxis[/b] from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1135230/Ember_Knights/]Ember Knights[/url]
[*][b]Tasmos[/b] from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1835240/Spiritfall/]Spiritfall[/url]
[/list]
If you haven't play these games you, we highly recommend you to try them and we might have the best reason for you, we created an [b]Action-Packed Roguelike Gems Bundle[/b] adding an[b] extra 10% off[/b] to all the games already discounted that you do not own already!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/cbb18cc03b8380032c19393ec010dd96a42d8da2.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/44735/ActionPacked_Roguelike_Gems/

We have also made a specific video about our collaboration with Ember Knights team as [b]they added Yalees as Spells in their game[/b]! :barbecuePog:

[previewyoutube=IH_XW0n_FVo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Version 1.7 complete Patch-Notes: [/b][/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/4607833411865476591

[h2]The Relentless Void[/h2]
A new room has been added to the game with this update, now you will find The Void to fight minibosses in each world up to 3 times in a run. If you pick it and win in world 1, 2 and 3, you will be able to find the [b]Relentless Void, a new type of Miniboss room[/b], coming with a new song!
[previewyoutube=jVQKuN5cNC0;full][/previewyoutube]
Minibosses there are harder than regular Minibosses with more patterns and more complex fights. For now there are 3 Minibosses in this room : Bodyboulder, Praxis or Tasmos.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/5caa1f70237efeb673cb24c0132bed9eec2ae95f.png[/img]
Why take the risk? Well... guaranteed Astral Gambits :taurusSmirk:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/096f7406f1b3b52267c3ca64768bed9624a89160.jpg[/img]

[h2]Forge Rework[/h2]
We have reworked the Forge Room, you used to be able to get random spells to pick but it was not very exciting and it was rarely giving you what you wanted so we follow a community suggestion and reworked it so you can now [b]select any spell of your hero[/b] and [b]with the affinity of your choice[/b]!

[previewyoutube=Su_4v83n0sc;full][/previewyoutube]

It is also working differently in co-op where you can select 2 times the reward and they only work for the player selecting the reward instead of working for both players at once.

[h2]Keys Converter[/h2]
Who never had leftovers of Keys at the end of a run? Well we might have the perfect solution for you!
[previewyoutube=c6Wo8adSUxA;full][/previewyoutube]
Convert your Keys into Stars to use for drinks right before the final fight and always maximize your efficiency :zimzimSmile:


[h2]Sneak Peak of 1.8[/h2]
We are aiming to release this new update for [b]October[/b], the main feature is a rework of the [b]Telluric Telescope[/b], we will modify the existing bonuses in the Telluric Telescope so we dont give bonuses that are linked to a specific build anymore as we think it felt bad.
We are also going to add new ones, mainly for the Telescope in the main hub but also in a new Room that you will be able to find during your runs!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/81f59f78be80cf2264b16dd3d550d6337720566b.png[/img]
[i]Visuals not definitive![/i]

In this new area you will be able to select an extra Telescope bonus but these bonuses will be mostly different from the existing ones and they will also be attached to negative temporary effects. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/bda569c0429f42645fc0534080efeb096fad6943.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/593aa877ebca5a7fd17817941523e4cc20aa4042.jpg[/img]
[i]Room and UI visuals are not definitive![/i]

[b]Bonuses examples[/b] (subject to change) - [list]
[*] The mana cost of the spell in slot 4 is remove
[*] Spells that cost 3 mana have a X% chance to not use mana
[*] Spell in slot 2 cost between 1 and 3 mana
[*] Reduces Echoes cooldown by X%
[*] On spell refresh, kill X random enemies
[*] X% chance to reset the signature spell when you use it
[/list]
[b]Maluses examples[/b] (subject to change) -[list]
[*] The rooms are hidden
[*] The signature spell is unavailable
[*] All spells cost 3 mana
[*] The damages can’t critical
[*] Max life reduced by X% 
[/list]

We are also working on a new feature so you will be able to show your past runs builds and be able to see your whole build at once!
[previewyoutube=F-evdItjDbg;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Very placeholder elements![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/b1d80a299dbd0df1b986908331cef0769cf60b4c.png[/img]
[i]Visuals not definitive![/i]

It was painful seeing the community share so many screenshots to share a  build so we hope this will be better this way and encourage everyone sharing their best builds :zagpls:

We really cannot wait to share with you what is coming, in particular for the 1.9 but we have even more collabs unannounced collabs coming from licences we love!

Have an excellent time in the game everyone :kiranThumbUp:

- The Hibernian Workshop Team

Read the full Patch Notes here
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/4174351172249174630

[h2]Reminiscing Mirror[/h2]

We have added a new feature in the Garden, next to Papa Yalee, the Reminiscing Mirror! 

You can interact with it to see all the [b]Pixel-Art Cinematics[/b], there is [b]38 cinematics in the 1.5 Update[/b] and it will go up to 40 in the 1.6 Yamat DLC.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/NMRppBmt/Astral-Ascent-Personnel-Microsoft-Edge-13.jpg[/img]

This should allow you to see what you still have to unlock, in particular for endings and you can see again these cinematics when you want! 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMDlpY2hmbWNzZHltYWFlemU3MjE4YzA2cWYyNzYyMmN6MWI5MzNqZiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/51fdw9dZjJSGNulgqn/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]A new cinematic has been added in 1.5[/b] linked to another important change.

[h2]Destiny Level 100 and Resilience Mode
[/h2]
Destiny Level maximum used to be 54, with a secret hidden at this level.

We were[b] surprised and amazed by the quantity of players who cleared the Destiny Level 54[/b] which is incredibly hard! We wanted to add more content for these players, we initially wanted to add a Destiny Level 100 with only Stats increase (more life and damage on enemies) in the 1.4 Update but we listened to feedback and decided to postpone it to 1.5 and make it a bigger than initially planned based on the initial reception of it. 

We re-balanced the elements that seemed too punishing in Destiny Level 54 to make it less frustrating, for example adding a cooldown when getting hit and losing max hp/mana/quartz. The ghosts spawning have a delay before attacking and the armor on enemies is less frequent. 

This makes Destiny Level 54 easier so you have more chance to get to see what's next!

For 1.5 version we decided to create [b]a new column of 5 elements[/b] in the Path of Destiny. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/zv5pQ6Fg/Prt-Scr-capture.jpg[/img]

This new column can only be activated if you did beat Destiny Level 54 first.

In a similar way of the 6 first Destiny Levels, the 5 last one need to be beaten one by one to get to progress.

[h3]Destiny Level 60[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/90tgFCQb/Astral-Ascent-Personnel-Microsoft-Edge-3.jpg[/img]
The first element is Ophiuchus Giant Swords falling on players during most rooms.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcDE2Ync5b2dhbnlzcWF0NHR2M2JjdGprZzRob3dqdDRzcnpoZHpqNCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/l1CquNG2f32X9aRSLU/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]Destiny Level 70[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/G3k5jJxD/Astral-Ascent-Personnel-Microsoft-Edge-4.jpg[/img]
The second element is [b]more Elites[/b] which also gives more Stars to also give a bit more power.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNnV1ZmRya3RyYTY2d2QwcGI2aGNrcnk1c2dnM2J0czg4dW44ZHZyMSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/IVQhsYA5Ei3nR5z4V1/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]Destiny Level 80[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/kXsY0JZX/Astral-Ascent-Personnel-Microsoft-Edge-5.jpg[/img]
The third element is [b]fighting 2 Star Guardians at once[/b], Star Guardians are a place that experienced players defeat easily so it makes the fight more complicated.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExemp1cXAzdGUxdDVxN2Q1OGFmM2YyMmxxY2NrOWwzbWtyc215ODh1biZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/xqicqkgfQDlR1XarmL/giphy.gif[/img]
You have 2 extra Gambits loots when defeating Star Guardians at this Destiny Level.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/SRrVbdgt/Astral-Ascent-3.jpg[/img]

[h3]Destiny Level 90[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/t4mSgrpK/Astral-Ascent-Personnel-Microsoft-Edge-6.jpg[/img]
The fourth element is even harder as it requires you to [b]fight 2 Zodiacs at once[/b] with their improved fighting skills from Destiny Level 6. 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExb2duMmo5NXdzMzYxOGh0YWx0MTY4Nnd4YmMxczAxbzR3Y2p0anljMiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/So7B4TNK0S00fPqpow/giphy.gif[/img]
You have 2 extra Auras loots when defeating Zodiacs at this Destiny Level.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/NfspkhMh/Astral-Ascent-2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Destiny Level 100[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/t4gvp0Qd/Astral-Ascent-Personnel-Microsoft-Edge-7.jpg[/img]
Finally the last element is making the Ophiuchus fight harder for a final climax. Ophiuchus summons 2 Shadow Clones in Phase 1 instead of 1 ( 1 by 1 ) and he summons 4 Shadow Clones in Phase 2 instead of 2 (2 by 2). Ophiuchus also [b]summons real Zodiacs[/b] you have to kill instead of Zodiacs only doing 1 attack. Finally [b]Ophiuchus also gets Elite Aspects[/b] that only happen during Shadow Clones and Zodiacs attacks to avoid impossible to dodge attacks during Ophiuchus patterns.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMXo4bzN1OTMzank2MXJqeWhkeGQ2MGgyZ2FyMzRjNHEzNDAwMjhqYSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/pHakaJa1MRbuY4agq3/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]
Glory is the main reward of finishing Destiny Level 100 as we already gave a big extra reward at Destiny Level 54 but we still [b]added an extra small ending to express our gratitude[/b] to players going this far in the game.

Each Destiny Level also adds damage and life to enemies and Zodiacs but the life added is not too high to avoid enemies becoming too tanky.

[h2]Resilience Mode[/h2]
We are also adding an option for players wanting to experiment the game but having a hard time doing it. [b]The Resilience Mode is similar to Hades God Mode[/b], if you activate it, the more you die the more resilient you become so it adapts to you so you can keep going in the game if you are stuck!
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/DynYpJxM/Astral-Ascent-Personnel-Microsoft-Edge-10.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/xdJsNKdc/Astral-Ascent-Personnel-Microsoft-Edge-11.jpg[/img]

[h2]Banning Spells[/h2]
You can now [b]ban spells, 3 per hero and 5 common spells[/b] so if you really do not like playing with some spells you can make sure you do not find them again in your runs!
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcTNjYjV1dWxobzNzOWp0M2QyeHZsNWRxOGJzNW42OGk1NjR1MGpzNCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/3rRN5dQpIctGPGZrL6/giphy.gif[/img]

[h2]Other smaller changes[/h2]

Burn Stacks can now go up to [b]more than 10 stacks[/b], if you had more than 10 stacks on an enemy you would lost the extra stacks while now they are kept. Combustions are also triggered faster than before when reaching 10 stacks.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcnJhYnJ6cXF1ZjUyaXBtdDIzemprN2VjM2Y1bnF4aGs5aXVyMW5nNiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/0VVri0IEaJZtQOas2b/giphy.gif[/img]

A Yalee in Echoes Island appears once you beat Destiny Level 6 once (like Yalee in Telluric Ruins) and allows [b]you to reset one time the Echoes choice[/b].
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/bYHmnYqH/Prt-Scr-capture-2.jpg[/img]

[b]Icons of Echoes[/b] you get from Void Catalyst and Telescope appear above player in the first room so you don't miss them.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/0NTVYb6Z/Astral-Ascent-Personnel-Microsoft-Edge-14.jpg[/img]

[b]New icons showing spells and gambits elemental affinities[/b]. This change is part of more changes coming to the game to better understand the loots affinities and effects. You do not need to open the spells anymore to see their affinity, we know that for gambits the affinities are more obvious but we also wanted to keep a consistency among loots.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/GpqFXtSv/Astral-Ascent.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/bNmL66DZ/PrtScr.jpg[/img]

Equipping [b]an Aura on the same Aura will increase its quality[/b] if Aura can be improved. 2 Common Auras become a Rare Aura and 2 Rares Auras become a Mythic Aura. 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZWMzNHEyZGh2eGd3dHF5aGJuMXIxZzczMW8yYXk4aTV2bHc2MjJsMyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/XI2jTWqukTJLASRlDp/giphy.gif[/img]


[h2]Yamat is coming![/h2]

The next update will be 5th character, [b]Yamat DLC[/b] and we will communicate more about it when possible, target is Summer 2024 but until then you can see her animated portrait!
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdTZvb2xjamk1ODNnaGNiYzJ3MXdidDI2eGhlOXo0NTZ4bDZuOWNwMyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9cw/YeQBFoL2j00EGnBrcl/giphy.gif[/img]

Have an excellent day everyone!

- The Hibernian Workshop Team

[hr][/hr][*][b]Resilience Mode: [/b]Option in Gameplay similar to Hades God Mode, if you activate it will reduce damage taken by 20% and +2% each time you die for a total of up to 80% and -1% each time you success a run.
[/list]

[list]

[/list]

[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ Kiran Weapon passive Flower Power now restores 2 charges instead of 1 when using King Counter 
[hr][/hr][*]Shielded Foes giving Armor Points to enemies in Destiny Levels has been reduced from 50% chances to 30% chances to give armor to enemies
[hr][/hr][*]Yalee Tickets and Memory Fragments loots are more frequent
[hr][/hr][*]Thunder Elite Aspect waits a bit longer before hitting for the first time and increased time between each hit + it cannot be too small as it used to be to avoid not seeing it behind an enemy + add of a red feedback visual to better see it + it doesn't hit anymore while fading out
[hr][/hr][*]Calie Gems Weapons Passive Aerial Strike cooldown from 8 seconds to 7 secs and the area of effect is bigger now
[hr][/hr][*]Reduced Shadow Clones health amount in World 1 and World 2
[hr][/hr][*]Vampiric Foes effect does not work anymore from Elite Aspects, Thorny Foes and Vengeful Foes
[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ The Master Ultimate bar doesn't charge anymore while summoning Heroes Clones

notes.title: 1.4 Update - The Arsenal Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! :zimzimSmile:

We are very happy to announce that the [b]1.4 version is out now on Steam[/b]! This time we could not do a simultaneous release on console as we had to release the update as soon as possible in order to be able to participate to a Steam festival in May but we will do our best to release it as soon as we can later this month!

You can check below our first trailer since 1.0 release to showcase the new changes! 

[previewyoutube=sLbXoOWWCoU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Patch Note [/h2]
Find the full Patch Notes here -
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/4188984694009010708


[h2]8 New Weapons[/h2]
Each hero received 2 new weapons for a total of 12 weapons to play with!
