As you can see,[b] the passives are very different from each others[/b] giving access to even more playstyles variations and they are meant to be more useful in certain situations than others, up to you to pick what you prefer!

[h2]What is next?[/h2]
The Arsenal was a massive update we really wanted to do to give more variety to the gameplay, we wish to keep adding more polish to the game when possible as we had to focus on the new content for this update. We also want to start working on Yamat, the 5th playable character update as soon as possible.

We will hope you will have fun with this update and thanks for supporting us!

The Physical editions are nearly ready, it took more time than expected but we will soon have delivered everything to Limited Run Games!

One last thing, we saw the community messages and decided to translate the game in Spanish for a future update! 

Have an excellent week! :taurusSmirk:

- The Hibernian Workshop Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - April 2024 - 1.4.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/6242ded5473885a37513cb08a5f0e84b1dacae9e.gif[/img]

⭐[i][b]Changes inspired by our community![/b][/i]


[h2]Major Features[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]The Arsenal : 8 new weapons and 36 passives for weapons unlockable with small quests

[h3]AYLA[/h3]
[b]Lunar daggers (Daggers):[/b]
[list]
[*] PARTING GIFT: Killing enemies burst 1 colored dagger out of their remains. It comes back to you after a few moments. 
[*] GLIDING STAR: Dash leaves behind a rotating shuriken that comes back to you after a few seconds. Only one can be out at a time.
[*] NIGHT VEIL: You gain an extra jump and each Double Jump flings a fan of kunais under you. 
[/list]
[b]Moonlight blade (Katana):[/b]
[list]
[*] RAY OF LIGHT: In each room, until you get hit, the last attack of your basic attack combo will launch a wave of light.
[*] STARFIRE: Dash through enemies while your signature spell is available will mark them. Using your signature spell calls upon a powerful ray of starfire on all of the marked enemies, consuming the mark in the process.
[*] JUDGEMENT CUT: After a spells_refresh, your next basic attack will be empowered to execute the healthiest enemy. Zodiacs and Star guardians are too powerful to be affected by this ability.
[/list]
[b]Eclipse shards (Claws):[/b]
[list]
[*] KUSARIGAMA'S FURY: On a Fall Attack you grab up to 5 enemies with a chain and pull them to you.
[*] INNER DEMON: Using your signature spell unleashes a clone in your initial position that flies back to you, shredding all enemies in its path.  
[*] HUNTER X HUNGER: The Hunt is On, you gain hunger stack that gives you 5% attack speed and 10% movespeed (up to 50% Movespeed) when killing enemies. You lose 1 stack every 1.5 seconds.
[/list]

[h3]KIRAN[/h3]
[b]Raging Fists (Fists):[/b]
[list]
[*] DOUBLE TAP: In each room, until you get hit, your basic attack does an extra punch.
[*] COME AND GET IT: On signature spell, you pull all those cowards right next to you to punch them better.
[*] FLOWER POWER: In each room, your first 4 basic attack are replaced by a fireball. Each time you use your signature spell you get 1 more fireball to throw.
[/list]
[b]Burning bo (Bo Staff):[/b]
[list]
[*] EXPLOSIVE TEMPER: When you successfully counter an attack with your signatire spell you do A HUGE EXPLOSION!!!!!
[*] BOGGO STICK: Your double jump becomes an awesome attack that works like a basic attack!
[*] MAGNETIC PERSONNALITY: In each room, until you get hit, the enemies are captivated by the last attack of your basic attack combo and assemble in front of you to admire it.
[/list]
[b]Diery falchions (Dual Falchions):[/b]
[list]
[*] HIT MARKER: Every 6 seconds, a mark appears on an enemy for a short period. Hitting them with a basic attack makes it explode.
[*] SANTÔRYÛ: A floating sword appears periodically. Catch it to earn its loyalty for the next 6 basic attack. After those, it will go back to its family and a new floating sword will appear after 7 seconds.
[*] SWORD JUGGLING: Every 10 seconds, your next basic attack will launch a rotating fire blade that comes back to you.
[/list]

[h3]CALIE[/h3]
[b]Polytechnical Gmmes (Gems):[/b]
[list]
[*] AERIAL STRIKE: Every 8 seconds, your next double jump will bombard the enemy positions in front of you with 5 feathers. Timeless classic.
[*] CONDUCTIVE PROPERTY: Using your signatire spell creates an energy orb on each gem and links them together with a damage-dealing energy. Practical.
[*] FIELD SUPPLIES: A crystal will grow on the ground after 5 seconds. You can destroy it with 3 basic attack to create 5 gems that you can recall with your signature spell. A thrifty solution.
[/list]
[b]Service Spear (Spear):[/b]
[list]
[*] CALL TO ARMS: When using your signature spell, you call forth spears that pierce the enemies around you for 2,2 seconds.
[*] WOLF HOLE: A mark will appear every 5 seconds on enemies around Calie. Doing a Top Attack will consume the mark and create an area attack around it, knocking the enemies toward Calie's position. 
[*] HOMING SPEAR: In each room, your first 2 basic attack throw a spear that can be called back to you. After a spell refresh you get 1 more spear to throw. Handy.
[/list]
[b]Unbreakable Rempart (Shield):[/b]
[list]
[*] SIEGE BREAKER: A destructible block will appear after 7 seconds. Breaking it will launch 3 damage dealing debris accross the battlefield. Disappointing craft.
[*] DEFENSIVE MEASURES: Using your signature spell creates a force field around Calie. Each gem recalled will be deflected by it and launched toward a nearby enemy. Impenetrable.
[*] AVENGING SHIELD: After 5 seconds, the last attack of your basic attack combo will launch a shield that bounces 6 times off enemies. Old efficient trick.
[/list]

[h3]OCTAVE[/h3]
[b]Pistor Vocatis (Dual pistols):[/b]
[list]
[*] ORBUS MINORIS: Every 8 seconds, you summon Pluto, a flying drone that follows you and attack enemies hit with a close-range basic attack. After 5 shots, it disappears. (Sad)
[*] CONIICIO IOCOR: A bullet appear after 5 seconds. Collecting it replaces your next {basic attack with a laser that ricochets up to 6 times between enemies. (Stylish)
[*] AUREA MERIDIES: When entering a Fight Room or an Eclipse Room, your first basic attack launch you into a flurry of laser, killing everything in sight. (Awesome!) 
[/list]
[b]Exterminatum Exemplaris (Rocket launcher):[/b]
[list]
[*] FRAGOR MORTIS: In each room, until you get hit, the last attack of your basic attack combo will launch 6 grenades around your target. (Radical)
[*] ORBITUM TERMINUS: Your signature spell calls a devastating strike firing 20 shots from orbit. (Total Annihilation)
[*] PRIORA SIGNA: An energy orb appears after 5 seconds. Shooting it with a basic attack detonates it, damaging all the enemies in the area.
[/list]
[b]Magnum Cupitere (Gunblade):[/b]
[list]
[*] SECO VERBERA: After a spell refresh, your next basic attack will create an energy orb and split it into a myriad of small projectiles that target nearby enemies.
[*] MISERIA LABRUM: Your Dash now deals damage and has 30% chances to mark enemies on hit. Hitting marked enemies with a basic attack deals extra damage and consumes the mark. (I hope she'll like it)
[*] ANIMA VAMPIRIS: After each kill, Octave stores his enemy's power into 1 orb (max 3). Your basic attack consumes 1 orb to release a powerful shot. (Is that what it felt like, Mother?) 
[/list]

notes.title: 1.3 Update - Affinity System, QoL and Arsenal preview!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

[b]We just released the 1.3 version on PC[/b]. This new version is focused on elements often requested by the community.

[h3]Patch Note[/h3]

Find the full Patch-Notes of 1.3 here - 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/7281829929758883013

[h3]Affinity System[/h3]

The most frequent request and complaint about the game since its 1.0 release was the lack of Synergy of your build during your run. Wanting to go in a direction and loots would go in another direction gave the feeling of being unlucky during the runs.

We have created a new system called the Affinity System that increases synergies of the loots depending of your current build so you are more likely to make a fully coherent build at the end of your run. Keep in mind that keeping some flexibility on the loots you find is still important, if you find something very powerful, you might still want to re-orient your build during your run!

We have also made Auras rarities stand out more on your interface.
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/044/342/717/be1125d1126af374c7ee61143bbcc0bd_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1710404138&gif-q=50&q=92&s=5f42365b23f8ddf991a561719dd1a24b[/img]


[h3]Destiny Fragments[/h3]

You will now be able to get up to 3 Destiny Fragments at once per Zodiac victory!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/044/342/698/d4eba9fa220449674ca7960cd2cba0f9_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1710403957&gif-q=50&q=92&s=b2d7f44f8e69b3851586bc83e6aa88e1[/img]

The way it currently works in 1.2 is this :

[list]
[*] You get 1 Destiny Fragment per Zodiac per Destiny Level (up to 54) and the Master gives 3 fragments per level, you can at best get 7 fragments in a run.
[*] If you defeat a Zodiac at a high Destiny Level, you will only get 1 Destiny Fragment and it will increase by 1 the Destiny Level you need to get a new fragment of this Zodiac.
[*] Ex : if you have all fragments of Taurus at Destiny Level 10, if you beat him at Destiny Level 20 you will get his 11th fragment, and you will need to beat him at Destiny Level 12 or more to get one new fragment.
[/list]

This system is slow, does not reward players wanting to take more risks in higher Destiny Levels and it exhausts the Master Destiny Fragments much faster than the Zodiacs fragments, this is how the 1.3 system works :

[list]
[*] You get from 1 to 3 destiny Fragments per Zodiacs depending on the difference between your current Destiny Level and the number of Destiny Fragments already collected from the Zodiacs.
[*] Ex : if you have all fragments of Taurus at Destiny level 10, if you beat him at Destiny Level 13 you will get 3 fragments. Then you will need to beat him at Destiny Level 14 or more to get new Destiny Fragments.
[*] The Master still gives 3 Destiny Fragment per Destiny Level and you cannot collect several ranks at once so your maximum Destiny Fragments per run is now 15 and the Master and Zodiacs fragments would exhaust at the same time if you win all your Destiny Levels runs.
[/list]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/044/342/700/fcec597932cb2d15d267ccea9132c585_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1710403967&gif-q=50&q=92&s=c35b4d528ca9fe2d4428d7ab821511be[/img]


[h3]Improved Descriptions[/h3]

We have made descriptions for Effects, Player Statuses and Elite Aspects much clearer adding details for how they work, durations, chances to add stacks in order to give you a clearer idea of what to expect from each of these elements.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/044/342/705/f2e42b181e1bd650863338ea12f1d91c_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1710403988&gif-q=50&q=92&s=e6b6476d1c242e9995c5a80a32ba73e0[/img]

Some Astral Auras also used Common Spells without giving informations on them, they now have the descriptions added as hints.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/044/342/701/fd276d4e18075ea35acf42ef3e8537d7_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1710403978&gif-q=50&q=92&s=fe9c902e86fb520490860523325b23ab[/img]

[h3]Permanent spell icon[/h3]

We added an option to make next spell icon always visible above your head. We know this option can help players having an hard time checking the icon during action.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/044/342/708/194b3eac78a09e9e2c92156dd686a7b4_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1710404001&gif-q=50&q=92&s=e8ac0b9aeb21291e8934cb7492b40ebe[/img]


[h3]Astral Dragons [/h3]

Small Astral Dragon now gives 3 Auras to choose from instead of 2 so you have more choices to start your build during the run.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/044/342/716/3c3665630e89162db105db653e56c69b_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1710404132&gif-q=50&q=92&s=25ead8ac259f6efe0b1e22dab85ed08e[/img]

We have also replaced the Void Catalyst element that increased strength when killing enemies without being hit by Barbecue's Grace giving the Echo of Barbecue to reroll the Auras you do not want with new Auras of same rarity. This gives even more choices to build during your runs.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/044/343/943/e18b50a1161af45daf35dfd1206dc271_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1710414818&gif-q=50&q=92&s=2ccde7cbc3878eae93e4ced9bc15f015[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/044/343/944/4ebaabd1701072e32f7bbf64324120e2_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1710414826&gif-q=50&q=92&s=e4ebce0a4325094cc66609cf4dbf9a63[/img]


[h3]Darker Background Option[/h3]

In order to give more options related to readibility, we added an option to make everything in background darker so enemies and players stand out much more.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/044/342/719/20de3add705bf9e5da9448698dd5159c_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1710404149&gif-q=50&q=92&s=84b14cb4937bf4f629c73046695c0fd3[/img]


[h3]Ultimate Challenge[/h3]

We sponsored Gellot ,a great content creator that performs very hard challenges on games, to do all Zodiacs no-hit at Destiny Level 6 which sounds ridicously hard but that wasn't even close to the challenge he did, making a no-hit on all Zodiacs at Destiny Level 54, it sounds really impossible but he made it!

Send him some love in the comments of the video for the incredible performance this is!

[previewyoutube=iIxvPwXTaks;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Arsenal Update Preview[/h3]

The Arsenal will be the next update, the 1.4, it will give each Hero 2 new weapons and 3 passives modifying gameplay of each hero, including for their base weapons.

We announced Ayla will have a Katana giving her more impactful attacks with a longer range.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/044/342/751/a4019fc25ef67c726297c0c185cf0c6b_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1710404554&gif-q=50&q=92&s=e1710c0160e343bbb2aacd89bc2cc513[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/044/342/753/c800d4b6a18314e56001b80e344c8c20_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1710404559&gif-q=50&q=92&s=9dd7314b4c906389f0cc14281c0e4f5b[/img]

Kiran will have a Double Falchions for large range attacks at a slower pace but keeping high mobility.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/044/342/744/fab3bcf74ee6747a3c88aa871c0cd63b_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1710404503&gif-q=50&q=92&s=9cbf2fdd1f726e2a2df8a71c5c2cd96a[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/044/342/747/7ea366ec3d814ae5f8cc22649f07f4ca_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1710404536&gif-q=50&q=92&s=408fcd0e3d7257db3063f1bcf17a87d5[/img]

Octave will have a Rocket Launcher to kill enemies from far but without auto-targeting, you will need to position correctly to hit your enemies, a bit similar to the one from Hades.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/044/342/763/0c4e089b2d2c834c03cd71f73e8fd13b_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1710404698&gif-q=50&q=92&s=98934ffe0b75483b9550f43632a1ffc0[/img]

Below, Octave has a passive creating grenades on the third Basic Attack.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/044/342/770/f457829402f5a9078d873897d3e3ebf3_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1710404791&gif-q=50&q=92&s=fc0966d0087830d9a6d33ac4981a334d[/img]

Calie will have Spears, all Signature Spells will keep working the same so the spears will create gems when attacking.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/044/342/696/4135c49af6caec439dc940ded5c4fe08_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1710403932&gif-q=50&q=92&s=2870b73631114a517ccca63d9a311206[/img]

And today we announce the second weapon of Octave : the Gunblade! Giving him the ability to fight at a closer range.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/044/342/695/319bd5bf6212913c17342b0a8548dc1c_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1710403914&gif-q=50&q=92&s=a0beb6364081b3cb32edfcaac904a99b[/img]

We are targetting for this update to release by the[b] end of April 2024[/b].


Have an excellent day

-The Hibernian Workshop

notes.title: 1.2 Update - PvP Arena, new Spells and more!
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch Note[/h2]
Find the full Patch-Notes of 1.2 here -
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/4061752935706427823

[h2]20 new spells[/h2]
We have added [b]5 new spells per Hero[/b], 2 of them are directly unlocked and you need to buy 3 of them at the Merchant. If you already have a rarer spells you won't need to unlock them with experience at the end of runs
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/978/078/b2680822b0b0276cc181a9a8ff1cb997_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1707747934&gif-q=50&q=92&s=359b41019424af35d1f2ffbd38cec85d[/img]

We received a lot of feedback saying you would like to see [b]more spells about making the enemies move[/b]. More spells making something else than pure damage. We have tried to include that as much as possible in our new spells design and we are really happy about these new spells!

[previewyoutube=KE00hg5KN44;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=jECeJTK3jxs;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=J-szP78AuBw;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=pp8i5Jj0wVg;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]PvP Arena[/h2]
[previewyoutube=253ruzlxSQA;full][/previewyoutube]

The PvP Arena is placed in Andromeda's Bar. It is accessible [b]only in local co-op during runs[/b] and you can make as many duels as you want. We had so much fun testing this new feature, we know it won't be used by everyone as it requires playing in co-op but during co-op runs it adds a lot of fun!
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/978/581/273c64dd18aca5e1945fa51a4907ae7a_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1707750558&gif-q=50&q=92&s=39c6f088b003fa4d21b0fa052b0f18fe[/img]

When you start the duel it will make you full life and full mana and it will restore the amount you had before the duel when getting out. 

During the duel both players get mana point with time so you can focus on launching spells more than attacking with Basic Attacks to restore mana. We also added some buff trees spawning sometimes to spice things up. We also removed the Echoes and Zodiac Summon during the duels, it was way too chaotic when it was possible.

The player winning the Duel will get a little crown symbol above their avatar as a reward for the run but it can change back to the other player if they win another duel.
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/978/458/0db04398f3060094732652bc570a4be6_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1707749965&gif-q=50&q=92&s=661ceafefc0f4de6516faa8d13a1ef13[/img]

We received a lot of questions relative to online PvP but we are not going for it as it requires so much work. We also thought about accessing the PvP from main menu or from the game hub but it would require a build creating system and we also know that the PvP is not balanced depending of the spells you currently have, it's mainly targeted to get some fun when you do co-op runs!

[h2]Extras[/h2]
Some noteworthy change mainly inspired by community suggestions!
[list]
[*] Offline Telescope - We have made the Telescope working offline now, it will solve the problem that it was not working in some regions of the world and it will also be available on Console now. 
[*] 4 Categories at Cetus Cavern - Cetus Cavern now has 4 categories instead of 3, the fourth one will always be the random one (Nebulous Choice)
[*] Pavo Feathers - Feathers on Pavo's ruins will always be of a higher level after sacrificing health 3 times (globally)[/list]

[h2]Arsenal Update Preview[/h2]
We have also started working on the next update : [b]The Arsenal[/b]. In this update [b]each Hero will have new weapons and associated passives[/b]. We will explain this better next time but for now you can see one of the new weapons of Kiran below - 
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/976/771/88f3fbfdf54260f5abaa16ea992be957_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1707736791&gif-q=50&q=92&s=533b61e28bee98430ee18d3873c1ae5c[/img]


[h2]Merch Suggestions event[/h2]
We are also [b]gathering your ideas about potential merch[/b] on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/hibernian-workshop]Discord Server[/url], you can give your own ideas and vote for other suggestions you like, do not hesitate to join!
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/978/848/aad911388aa5e020ec6a37ae44d63cf9_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1707751690&gif-q=50&q=92&s=00c9a170101d0c0682de9761fa579c31[/img]

Have a great time in the game and a fantastic week,

- The Hibernian Workshop Team

Hello everyone!

We are back from holidays and we are working on our next update coming on [b]February 12[/b]! ːtaurusSmirkː

[h2]PvP Arena and public beta[/h2]
We have made great progress on the PvP Arena and it turned out even better than we anticipated, it is so fun to play! We will explain better everything related to it in the update news but for now here is a work-in-progress video.

[previewyoutube=253ruzlxSQA;full][/previewyoutube]

To select the public beta, open Steam then :
[code] [list][*] Right click on Astral Ascent in your Library
[*] Click on Properties
[*] Open Betas tab
[*] Select "public.beta"[/list][/code] 
The public beta already has a change related to [b]Telescope making it offline now[/b] and if you see any issues related to spells or during the PvP it would be very appreciated if you could report them to us, thanks!

[h2]New Spells[/h2]
We have also started working on [b]5 new spells per hero[/b], these new spells feel very cool to use and we tried to make some of them move enemies around as it was something often requested by the community!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/705/778/ba7c799f661983f7f6da40c594681d00_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1705595010&gif-q=50&q=92&s=bfa54e4e5f509cd016cf6158babc7290[/img]

[h2]Other Changes Coming[/h2]

notes.title: Japanese voice-over + Damage Meter Update is Live
notes.notes:
[h1]Astral Ascent 1.1.0 is live![/h1]
Let's dive into the details of what is new in this new update!

You can see the complete Patch Notes here
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/3900744344840803063

[h2]Japanese voice-over[/h2]

We just loved the community calling us an "anime roguelite" (some of the late-game cinematics are really inspired by some animes!) and we decided to make a Japanese voice-over version of all the dialogs. It was a lot of work with the 7800+ dialog lines and 27 voiced characters but we assembled a great team to deal with this task and we are super happy with the result. Each character has so much personality and it is an always renewed joy to discover all the dialogs in a different language. You can listen to some of these new recordings below -

[previewyoutube=sVg9HNcXcv4;full][/previewyoutube]

 You will have a launching screen to choose the voice-over language one time now, we were afraid all this work would go unnoticed if we did not add a specific screen for it.


[h2]Brazilian Portuguese Translation[/h2]

Having members of our team from Brazil, we are very happy to have the game translated in Brazilian Portuguese!


[h2]Small Astral Dragon[/h2]

We pay a very close attention to the community feedback about the game and one of the most requested change is being able to have more control over the builds we are creating. With this in mind, we added a new Zim-Zim upgrade named "Small Astral Dragon". (also works in co-op!)
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/439/073/457a68581cbcfa70602bbf490ed44768_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1703157208&gif-q=50&q=92&s=0bfc6ac7e6a1030fb211206e5359b031[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/439/079/1195c18c8286f18fb337b8b8dd76c874_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1703157236&gif-q=50&q=92&s=91ab766ea0a116647d72b345fe3c918d[/img]

At first rank you have the choice between 2 Common Auras and at last rank you have the choice between 2 Mythic Auras. Everytime, Auras have 20% to be of an higher rarity level so you can sometimes start with an Astral Aura. Though we did not want to encourage what we consider being an unfun behavior - relaunching the game many times to get a different Aura - we made the game remember which Aura should appear.

We placed this Dragon at the very beginning of the first intro room so you can have an aura before taking the level up statue and have an initial target build to focus on. But do not forget, this is a simple first step into your build, if you started with a poison Aura and only find freeze oriented elements you can switch to it! As Bear Grylls said : Improvise. Adapt. Overcome!

As an addition for easier builds, we have added another gambit slot at the merchant in Andromeda's bar. It is not fun to reset many times the choices in order to find the right affinities and it should be a little easier now!
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/439/447/25c376d8d250be0c7f5f4f03995e8231_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1703162603&gif-q=50&q=92&s=56ea1e252a21c471d0cda9271f335af5[/img]


[h2]The Telluric Yalee[/h2]

Another feedback we received was not getting frequently enough the spells you prefer. Instead of garanting certain spells or banning some others, we implemented a Yalee in the Telluric room, this Yalee appears when you defeated the Master once (in Destiny Level 0) and can reset the spells choices for a small amount of Sun Pieces. We kept the amount low so it always feel fine to use and not frustrating.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/439/434/cb058a1c5987d72a18f1ca79f8518272_original.webp?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1703162384&gif-q=50&q=92&s=55af8f78a7127ebd844a86e28936c446[/img]

We have been looking for a moment now on what could we do with extra Sun Pieces collected. It was supposed to be the Small Astral Dragon for a large amount of Sun Pieces but we felt like it was too important to have it unlocked early and to have this starting Aura in all runs so we reworked very recently to implement it as a Zim-Zim upgrade and we will try to find something else to do with the Extra Sun Pieces in the future!


[h2]New Explorations Room[/h2]

We added 10 new exploration rooms level design variations for each world in this update

We have made a poll on our Discord Server to know what you would like to see implemented in the game and the results really surprised us! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/439/521/771d28652f57f1039be6aa6c36a744c1_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1703163349&gif-q=50&q=92&s=6378bde73f428c34bb73135e55576c81[/img]

We created a Roadmap (see below) to take these feedback into consideration.

[list]
[*]  [b]A - Metaprogression content -[/b] making more heroes spells as soon as possible for February 2024 update, we have already created some and we tried to focus on making as many spells as possible focusing on creating gameplay like moving enemies or heroes etc as you feedbacked us.
[*]  [b]B - Ingame content -[/b] nothing planned for now given the poll results
[*]  [b]C - New games modes -[/b] PvP is planned for February 2024 and a new very cool mode is coming for Q4 2024, giving it a low priority given this poll
[*]  [b]D - Harder challenges - [/b]nothing planned for now given the poll results
[*]  [b]E - Exploration runs variety -[/b] 10 new exploration rooms level design variations available now! We made it a priority due to the poll.
[*]  [b]F - Combat runs variety -[/b] we planned an altervative world to come alongside Yamat update on Q3 2024!
[/list]
Talking a bit more about the future below.


[h2]Damage Meter System[/h2]

This is the most biggest change of this update, it registers all the damage you input to any enemies for your current room and globally (also works in co-op). You can pause the game to open the "Damage Meter" option in the menu to see this -
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/439/754/28e89ae8e0aad8bd34dc48a1b89c35cc_original.webp?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1703165198&gif-q=50&q=92&s=e98770ba4e5d81c420eae4075ab93316[/img]

There is also an overlay option that is "Off" by default and you can activate it to show the top 5 elements of either the global damage of your run or of the current room and it looks like this -

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/439/780/718c95c58234d21c384caa7ba4664f5c_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1703165475&gif-q=50&q=92&s=77c155313cee9d8594ac172215b90e21[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/439/777/c97ab5efc00da5f19b08cfec63e74c97_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1703165459&gif-q=50&q=92&s=8cb37b5ecc29cca09ea6e4aba9eb2f10[/img]

For those worried, it's not overlapping with much elements from the interface, we limited it to 5 elements showcased at once.

This new system is inspired by mmorpg addons making it possible to see what causes damage at any time in your build. Our goal is to make you fully understand your build, how it works, how it synergies and what deals damage in it. 

We think that's not something very common but we have a lot of synergizing elements that we think it's really important in our game. Even if we made our very best during the development, this new tool is probably going to show a lot of unbalanced elements so you can expect changes based on our observations in the coming months.


[h2]Lisibility and Readability[/h2]

Among the reported feedback from the community, lisibility is something that we see a lot, we made so many changes regarding this during the development but we are still not there yet. 

Most of games similar to Astral Ascent use a dark background because it makes everything stands out instantly  but we really wanted the game to be colorful, it is definitively more work though! 

In this update we increased lisibility again, we reduce some visuals FX, we set as many as possible behind everything, add some transparency on elements and so on. We have also added an option to remove Damage Numbers if you don't want them being visible on the screen.
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/439/977/8febb4cb66e19a0bdbb11be9e3609b07_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1703167572&gif-q=50&q=92&s=1146712ce053fd7ada1c025fa23d63ff[/img]


[h1]What is next ?[/h1]
We hope we will enjoy this update, as a reminder here is our 2024 Roadmap if you missed it -

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/439/997/a0ae479b75bf53e5c66fddc39fd61dc7_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1703167684&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=e0e48a3966d213db4b874385e76d0213[/img]
We are going to take a well deserved break for the holidays season! Things have been really intense during 2023 with frequent major updates. You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930]check this link[/url] to see all the newsletters we released on Steam since 2020 to see how much the game evolved and how much we progressed as a team!

For now the game keeps selling well and for now it gives a nice future for the game and for our studio and we really appreciate players following us as developers and not just for a specific game, that goes right to our hearts!

That's the last news of this very intense year, 2024 should be easier for us. I will sound like a broken record but thanks again for following us, sharing and caring about Astral Ascent and we will keep you updated about what is next for the game in January!


Have an excellent holiday season everyone and thanks again! 

- The Hibernian Workshop Team

notes.title: 2024 Roadmap + December Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today we celebrate our 1 month anniversary since the 1.0 release ːzimzimSmileː

We are still overwhelmed by all the positive feedback we receive, thanks so much for that! 

This reception motivated us to keep improving Astral Ascent so we decided to publish our [b]2024 Roadmap[/b] that was influenced by the answers we received from a poll we made on our [url=http://discord.gg/hibernian-workshop]Discord server[/url].

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/377/406/a0ae479b75bf53e5c66fddc39fd61dc7_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1702545179&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=3b79701d137d77f21edc812bbd4922a4[/img]

The Roadmap can still change but will remain similar to this. But before all this new content we would like to focus a bit more on what is coming up next week, on December 21st - the [b]Damage Meter Update[/b]!

[list]
[*] A new [b]Damage Meter syste[/b]m so you will know exactly what deals what damage at anytime.
[*] [b]Full Japanese Voice-Over[/b], "anime roguelite" is becoming real
[*] [b]Translation of the game in PT/BR[/b]
[*] [b]10 new exploration rooms per worlds[/b]
[*] A [b]mini dragon[/b] in first Intro Room giving an Aura choice right away to [b]orient your build[/b] (Zim-Zim upgrade)
[*] Possibility to[b] reset Telluric Ruins spells[/b] with Sun Pieces
[*] A lot of debug and balancing
[/list]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/369/085/28e89ae8e0aad8bd34dc48a1b89c35cc_original.webp?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1702476067&gif-q=50&q=92&s=94ef62e0ddd859502bbaaef866ee6cef[/img]
[i]Complete damage meter menu[/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/369/087/53011863ca5a1a0257fcdf71e36368e0_original.webp?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1702476083&gif-q=50&q=92&s=e171bcb03a1190abf9f0991a8930e6a0[/img]
[i]Small damage overlay of either global damage / current room damage or turned off.[/i]

[hr][/hr]

We think this system is something very interesting to implement for people enjoying making builds. We are having tons of fun playing with it to see what is making damage and how synergies/builds work together but of course this is also going to show what is too weak or too strong so you can expect a lot of balancing to happen after this update!

We are reading all your feedback about the game, we saw a lot of[b] feedback about lisibility[/b] and we improved a lot of things regarding it (including a new option to [b]turn off the damage numbers[/b]) and the difficulty to create coherent builds (we added some elements above but we have also added [b]one more gambit altar at the Merchant[/b] for example)

[hr][/hr]


Thanks a lot and have a fantastic day!


- The Hibernian Workshop Team

notes.title: 1.0 is Out Now!
notes.notes:
After [b]more than 4.5 years of work[/b] with 18 months of Early Access, we are very proud to share with you all the[b] 1.0 version of Astral Ascent[/b]! We gave our very best during the whole development and you witnessed the evolution of the game that changed so much from Kickstarter demo to 1.0! 

We truly hope you will enjoy this version as much as we do (we play the game a lot as we are having so much fun on it!). [b]The more success the game will have the more updates we will make[/b] (we have many ideas already!) so do not hesitate to share the game around if you enjoy it! 

We also want to take this opportunity to tell you once more how important was all your support during the Early Access, it gave us a lot of motivation and inspiration, thanks for that <3 

You can see below the[b] Launch Trailer[/b] to celebrate the [b]Release on PC / PS4 / PS5 and Nintendo Switch[/b]!
[previewyoutube=wV9Q3xnRaq8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Main Game + OST + Artbook Bundle[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36431/Astral_Ascent__OST__Artbook_Bundle/

[h2]Original Soundtrack[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455290/Astral_Ascent_Original_Game_Soundtrack/

[h2]Digital Artbook[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2633220/Astral_Ascent_Artbook/



If you were already playing the game on Early Access, the 1.0 comes with a lot of changes! More than 1000 lines of change to read in our 1.0 Patch Notes.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/3776891376332040308


[h2]The Master[/h2]
 You will finally be able to face The Master, a final confrontation to escape from the astral prison! We do not want to spoil anything about it but there is a lot about this final boss, it took us as much time as the 3 other Zodiacs combined.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/504/f8eeb2b07d6f9e42596cb0ff589697d3_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699694759&gif-q=50&q=92&s=606f2f296563960a766b77c98db78be3[/img]

 [img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/511/3b741b30ff381423dbf8957ef19f7fe5_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699694817&gif-q=50&q=92&s=c1814694afaf23daf8e8a1970492e07c[/img]
 
 Beating The Master will also lead you to the 17 different Endings of the game!
 
[h2]Aries[/h2]
 Aries is super friendly but she will not hold her attacks on you!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/520/7f54cdf2bd039b81ca8d0d9dee4f9e1d_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699694942&gif-q=50&q=92&s=94098f0f388be4724fe902a1ef0c663e[/img]

 [img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/523/eca07ebff54204c5da30f522f940bdf8_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699694999&gif-q=50&q=92&s=2e0ee850b29fc31414507d6c9791ef5a[/img]
 
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/527/89ddd3f53fee3a6b6f16b41c594eaf02_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699695034&gif-q=50&q=92&s=1565ba4e63a7e1797413429da937cbec[/img]


[h2]Cancer[/h2]
 Cancer is the leader of the Orphnées family, he fights with a bird named Basileus. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/552/3d6f75e3fb966afe3a50e40d4dfb0f98_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699695732&gif-q=50&q=92&s=b6974599415dd1053dc6a14a6c452d19[/img]

 [img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/555/45bd18e184bd97b5eaa743e9f3d1f981_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699695775&gif-q=50&q=92&s=7d69031d96dbdd1b6b9567bc2f0b2b78[/img]
 
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/557/57db973e13f0ab318d526276dea9130b_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699695810&gif-q=50&q=92&s=bd8f1a43288a8992a0448025f05b5a6b[/img]


[h2]Gemini[/h2]
 Gemini are special, expect an intense fight facing multiple threats!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/563/2ea7407aaacba4343ef744936f573c88_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699695862&gif-q=50&q=92&s=0c8e60ab7024dffeb2960d980c05ac65[/img]

 [img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/564/e57e1d98ba34b441f12993f09afa57bc_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699695905&gif-q=50&q=92&s=08e7e0819a19411b42edb1e3fe7ffaaa[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/566/6e2b0c8779f356d681688421cd8857ac_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699695927&gif-q=50&q=92&s=456b4b38d71844dd3431107581b3c3f8[/img]

 
[h2]Star Guardians - Monoceros and Sculptor[/h2]
 Monoceros and Sculptor are joining Pegasus, Lupus, Draco and Hydra as minibosses you can encounter during your escape attempts! 

We think it's important for these Fights to not feel too repetitive. You can only face 3 of them maximum per escape attempt. They hit hard but we want you to pick these fights only if you feel comfortable during your run!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/570/be23ab70ed88d8ae53fadadfca6936ed_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699696024&gif-q=50&q=92&s=b61eb98893aeed7caf7c67a4617b74d3[/img]
 Monoceros is based on ice attacks!
 
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/573/b6001a3ab41b43ec90449c28bbfbc94d_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699696058&gif-q=50&q=92&s=2f33989c7c6ccf5d33f6b3f19adef52a[/img]
 Sculptor creates weapons to attack you!


[h2]Animated Cinematic[/h2]
We now have a traditional cinematic introduction when launching the game, giving a mood and first impression we absolutely love. The animations of Tokkun Studio fit perfectly the music of Dale North for an epic introduction to the Astral Ascent universe.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/578/41b03dc4b9b7987676fb008b83871d39_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699696091&gif-q=50&q=92&s=71bdea8ae4c69b1dfce4fba455086ba0[/img]

 
[h2]Reworked Introduction and Tutorial[/h2]
 We think the game introduction was not exposing the story and universe enough, we have created a new introduction cinematic! 
It is also an introduction to Ayla who did not have a proper pixel-art cinematic yet, it comes with a complete change of Ayla personality and backstory!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/583/8448687fd12e921d38ee7a8b7628feaf_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699696113&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=10828c75e400c3241bd1a9f7e1950f20[/img]
 
For the tutorial itself, we thought the previous one was too static and frustrating because we created a game focused on aerial movement and the tutorial was forcing you to not move much. The new tutorial gives you a total control over your movements from the very start now!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/585/9042764d4de0f937084b67c53a5e6d4b_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699696129&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=65ae3cdf1b69b6a9200a9f2699f5656d[/img]

 [img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/586/14fdaa70d014ffb5cfca95e28d2acb45_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699696139&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=9cc4b3b1721359f73ad837b160809be5[/img]
 

[h2]Event Horizon[/h2]
 You will not be automatically killed when accessing the Event Horizon (5th world), instead you will have many elements to prepare before the final confrontation!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/588/78efc744e78b1e4a5f693b36c632eb3f_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699696165&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=acf1eb5a6cdaa8b270a1dcb436d84aab[/img]

 [img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/589/53a9e87414ccd59491b687d34e22c670_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699696173&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=f503c6210bc383d564ec30825a0c2c22[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/590/14b4383377a9a1a18ca5528bf293c92f_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699696181&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=a9c05e6f890506e333eb50c0600b82c9[/img]
 

[h2]Mid-run Saves[/h2]
 This might be the most requested features from the 18 months of Early Access, everytime the icon below appears, you can open your options and safely quit to main menu and resume later. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/594/054948ce5e55e5650ddc513f7b64fc27_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699696215&gif-q=50&q=92&s=1e31ba02260e3a03ec8c8593ec0c4d8a[/img]

Combined to Steam cloud you can even do a run on your PC and continue your run on your Steamdeck for example!
[previewyoutube=yM7mlYQ5Cr0;full][/previewyoutube]

 
[h2]Beyond level 8[/h2]
 Maximum level you can reach per escape attempt is 12, once level 8 reached you have 4 perks for your Signature spell and 4 for your Basic attacks but now each level above level 8 allows you to replace one perk to optimize your build even more at the end of your runs.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/627/d7f47295af5472ce23c8839d6fd6cf6e_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699696649&gif-q=50&q=92&s=54f9586932b9496e3f4d59f3cd9d02e0[/img]

 
[h2]Stats Window
[/h2] It was not easy to know how your current build is impacting your base stats, now you will be able to see the stats anytime when opening your inventory or all the time by activating an option in the Gameplay menu.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/628/2ee123ba18614ad2b68748ff02f0228f_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699696664&gif-q=50&q=92&s=77f2701c5ab5e46d2eac44376c42ea3c[/img]

 
[h2]Itinerant Peddlers[/h2]
 We have made the itinerant peddlers much more interesting. As the spells did not have much and no gambits on them, in late-game it felt not right to pick new spells.

Now prices are much more varied and spells can have gambits on them, impacting their prices up to 2000+ Quartz a spell. You can also find and buy astral Gambits there making Quartz currency much more interesting that it was!

 We have also changed the altars to see the elements of spells and the rarity of gambits for a better lisibility.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/633/91dc7ce7b58ae000ea5a88fbc3301591_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699696716&gif-q=50&q=92&s=54a4d44e3419c7baa0dc8eb9389019d5[/img]

 
[h2]Storytelling Elements[/h2]
 Narration has been extended and reworked a lot, there is a lot of changed dialogs and many new types of dialogues. For example you can now have self conversations on benches and heroes talk to each others.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/634/87cda774407cf64299c4ebf1f707056a_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699696736&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=20b777dd7db626f49c0e49f8ee9f0345[/img]

 [img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/635/cb90b40949bc6bccc7468307004ae480_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699696744&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=518bbe22406c684fea661a86b33b6da4[/img]
 
 Most Memory Fragment have been modified too to give a more complete story of every characters.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/636/582856964faada0e3f811fa67bce99ff_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699696754&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=e813f28cd94d8f4288ce7ac25936dade[/img]

 
[h2]Co-op icons[/h2]
 We have given a lot of attention to co-op, one example is these icons that have been requested a lot by the community! But there is many other changes making the co-op experience more enjoyable!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/043/022/638/708272ea98112348e6bbc5fcd5533ed2_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1699696775&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=e23dbca6fbb65f7789fda7dde3a9e10c[/img]

 
If you want to interact with the community, report bugs or make suggestions, you can join our [url=http://discord.gg/hibernian-workshop]Discord Server[/url]! 

[url=http://discord.gg/hibernian-workshop][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/3030bf6ed27458f008f464c791a247cf60e1fcec.gif[/img][/url]

Thanks for supporting us through this journey and have fun playing the 1.0 version of the game!

- The Hibernian Workshop Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/6242ded5473885a37513cb08a5f0e84b1dacae9e.gif[/img]

⭐[i][b]Changes inspired by our community![/b][/i]

[h2]Major Features[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Final Boss: [/b]Face the Master in an epic boss fight!
[hr][/hr][*][b]Mid-run Saves: [/b]You can save and resume your runs at the start of any rooms.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Traditional Cinematic Introduction: [/b]Fully traditional hand animated cinematic when launching the game!
[hr][/hr][*][b]New tutorial: [/b]
- New introduction cinematic explaining the world when launching a game.

- New dynamic tutorial replacing the old one in the hub.

- Reworked dialogues and storyline of the introdctuion.
[hr][/hr][*][b]17 Unique Endings: [/b]Ending for each hero and each Zodiac if you have them as summons for a total of 17 endings with narrated stories with pixel art animated screen for each of them.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Complete Voice Acting: [/b]Extended and completed voice acting with over 7800+ lines of dialogues for 27 different characters.
[hr][/hr][*][b]New Storytelling Elements: [/b]
- Benches dialogues progression, heroes thoughts.

- Dialogues between heroes.

- Many extended dialogues types, each NPC from the Garden has things to say and a lot of dialogues are longer than before.

- Extended and reworked Memory Library entries for final background story of all characters. (104 stories)
[hr][/hr][*][b]Event Horizon: [/b]This room now has many things to do in it before the final confrontation.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Beyond level 8: [/b]When you are level 9 or more (maximum 12) you can now replace perks you already have, one perk replacement per level. We think this is useful because first perks we take might not fit our end build so it is one more option to make the best possible build.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Current Stats Window: [/b]You can now display your current stats (Strength/Critic/Mana/Life/Armor/Attack speed) by opening your inventory. It allows you to have a better understanding of your build and it can also be visible permanently by activating an option.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Aries, Cancer & Gemini: [/b]
- 3 new Zodiac fights with their animated pixel-art introduction.

- 3 new Zodiac spells: Aries Fire Trails, Cancer's Tsunami & Gemini's Scythe.

- 3 new Challenges and summons.
[hr][/hr][*][b]5 New Musics: [/b]Discover complete OST with many orchestral versions and featuring vocalist Emi Evans for the Master songs.
[hr][/hr][*][b]New Star Guardians: [/b]Monoceros and Sculptor join Pegasus, Lupus, Draco & Hydra for a total of 6 minibosses and 13 main bosses.
[/list]
[h2]Small Features[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Taurus Challenge: [/b]
- Dummies now have more life and their life depends of current world instead of behind the same in each world.

- Fixed bug where effects (wisps, spirit swords, nimbus etc.) could hit targets before the challenge started and prevent from finishing it.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Virgo Challenge: [/b]
- Dummies now have more life and their life depends of current world instead of behind the same in each world.

- Instead of dealing same amount of damage, Virgo damages to dummies now depends of world and she also focus .
[hr][/hr][*][b]Pisces Challenge: [/b]
- Reduced time and number of notes to collect.

- Added sound when you hit a red note.

- Sentence clarification for the objective.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Leo Challenge: [/b]
- Balanced damage of Leo per world and dummy can accumulate more maximum damage so it's not a last minute rush anymore.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Sagittarius Challenge: [/b]
- Increased the number of arrow that Sagittarius can shoot.

- Added sound when the players get hit by the the arrows.

[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ In Coop, P1 and P2 icons above head to differenciate each other.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Scorpio Challenge: [/b]
- Added red feedback on Scorpio spears.

- Added more time for the challenge.

- Reduced the time before the challenge starts.

- Added sound when the players get hit by a spear.

- Added visual assets to show in which direction you have to go to reach the end of the level as it could confusing sometimes.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Libra Challenge: [/b]
- Improved visuals and sound on player and Libra attacks.

- The camera is more zoomed and centered to better see the action and inputs.

- The player now uses now different animations.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Zodiac spells affinity: [/b]Zodiac spells can also be of neutral elemental affinity now.
[hr][/hr][*]326 Aura: Ignition poison is now purple.
[hr][/hr][*]334 Aura: Plasma of fire are now red.
[hr][/hr][*]Astral Auras rarity symbol is now on both sides of title everywhere.
[hr][/hr][*][b]New Achievements for Sier Bapy: [/b]
-Clumsy: Enemies defeated using Claw traps

-Laserified: Enemies defeated by giant lasers

-Practice Makes Perfect: Used Signature spell

-Stones of Power: Equipped stones from Staone Altar

-Optimal Affinity: Spells completed with Gambit affinity

-Ultimate Assassin: Reach maximum level with Ayla

-Strongestest Fist: Reach maximum level with Kiran

-Revenge is a Dish Best Served Cold: Reach maximum level with Octave

-Perfect Gems: Reach maximum level with Calie

-Wish Maker: Auras equipped

-Aura Mythic Wish: Aura mythic equipped

-Aura Astral Luck: Aura Astral equipped

-Friends Forever: Echoes following you

-Benched: Bench stories heard

-Water Companion: Visit Cetus

-Blood Pact: Life sacrified to Pavo

-Guardian Angel: Met your Zodiac sign

-Stars Vanquisher: Defeated Star Guardians in The void

-Bapy achievement for memory fragments up to max (104 stories)
[hr][/hr][*]All spells previews videos in the Merchant and Loots have been recaptured and improved.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Improved Merchant in Andromeda's Bar: [/b]
- Global visual improved

- All prices rebalanced

- Merchants can now sell Astral Gambits and spells equipped with random between 1 to 4 Gambits (including astral gambits) and random between 2 to 4 slot unlocked

- Spell altars now indicate the spell element

- Gambit altars now indicate the rarity

notes.title: The Telluric Telescope Update is Live! 🌠
notes.notes:
We went bigger than what we expected for this update, the Update is adding a [b]various range of new elements mainly focused on extending runs variety![/b]

Full Patch-Notes of 0.47
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/3690190742433248908

[h1]The Telluric Telescope[/h1]
Sier Bapy has a surprise, he repaired a precious telescope that can [b]absorb cosmic energy[/b].

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/053/343/c8b1a62969aa602c8ed8b523a2b0c5d6_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1692865126&gif-q=50&q=92&s=2b8686a6314d22a1553cea5096b7e799[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/053/089/8b74213d1733a14841f1d4531fc8bc4d_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1692863300&gif-q=50&q=92&s=a6ec114f50d625df1c692ce2e4c75acd[/img]

Everyday you can select [b]1 bonus among 3 different ones[/b] so each run feels even more unique! It can also help you decide which build you will try to do during your run and [b]make you experiment with builds you are not used to[/b]!

There is [b]more than 50 different bonuses[/b] to choose from :
[list]
[[i]*] First spell you equip is duplicated and replaces all your spells
[*] First Aura you find in Yalee Kingdom is Astral
[*] Increase Damage on full life enemies by 100%
[*] When starting an escape, gains 5 Critical Stones
[*] Summoning an Echo gives you a random buff
[*] Reduces by 30 the life cost of Pavo sacrifices
[*] etc.[/i]
[/list]


Once equiped, your bonus will be displayed on your portrait -
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/053/340/13e639f2d6e25e3a64b054c470c5d33a_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1692865104&gif-q=50&q=92&s=33c1dba918588958784b96a268b116b1[/img]

[h1]Echoes Extension[/h1]
We have [b]improved Echoes and extended their number, from 15 Echoes to 31[/b]! We have also reworked their preview visuals to better represation of what they are about and to better distinguish each one.
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/053/380/46a03902c3bbb5d22b1269245f9ae895_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1692865337&gif-q=50&q=92&s=e274ce94ac150a551da95121adbbf4a8[/img]

In order to keep finding the Echoes you like more frequently we have [b]increased the options pool from 3 to 4[/b]!
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/053/382/ec73529db556a4914e8a53b0c54d04a7_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1692865352&gif-q=50&q=92&s=4257e482a3a902a43eefe8b867d07836[/img]

Preview of some of the new Echoes -
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/053/413/3861481f4b604986bae837637269341a_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1692865505&gif-q=50&q=92&s=5e42eccf251524a7b8100d66a49c4b76[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/053/418/1a645cac72d76cb0a047a43a597ce314_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1692865523&gif-q=50&q=92&s=d28976b0f1978389d575c915569128f5[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/053/419/6242192cb32cec2929e5fb9d9be7b1ce_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1692865539&gif-q=50&q=92&s=59a08749dceef265a16aeb36fbcf1db2[/img]

[h1]Elemental Summons[/h1]
[b]All Zodiac Summons are now linked to an effect, same for Echoes[/b]. Together Zodiacs and Echoes summons [b]cover all existing effects in the game[/b].

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/053/465/992a7cbf90b4ad1be4a3ed5a9edd458f_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1692865772&gif-q=50&q=92&s=7f41f45681d9cc11b2f3280bacd46ef3[/img]
Taurus will now give 4 Spirit Swords

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/053/468/ae0f3a20428590edd7fadf40a1aab43e_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1692865792&gif-q=50&q=92&s=c54b93960403a8313f229c8cf3d68f56[/img]
Pisces now spawn Ice Swords on hit

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/053/475/6c26b9c3437cab540d5a06f7d874e6c9_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1692865829&gif-q=50&q=92&s=97807f9fbb927cf3f9dbb84152c52937[/img]
Capricorn summon will also create Meteors during its summon.

We have also improved interface visuals of Zodiacs summon chests -
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/053/480/bda23eaa521207ee13519dd088a232a9_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1692865881&gif-q=50&q=92&s=ea71253e584ff64e161d0e0647425142[/img]


[h1]New Void boss - Hydra[/h1]
[b]Hydra is joining[/b] Pegasus, Lupus & Draco as Void Bosses, 2 new ones will come for Final Release. Hydra manipulates the elements and is a dangerous foe, be careful!
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/091/766/3a45cdd536d538ea49dfa40359368d67_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1693207440&gif-q=50&q=92&s=40a3ad1f3b58eed1faec3c2d37d36007[/img]


[h1]Andromeda's Trials[/h1]
We have reworked some existing Trials that were too easy, we think it is fine for Trials to be a bit hard because you have no punishment for failing them. We have also created [b]many new Trials, from 8 to 17[/b].
Here are some new ones -
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/091/788/4ec223fede2ca2acd7b2628660e17144_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1693207625&gif-q=50&q=92&s=033dcbbae97f82d217b10aa5bf8d8d60[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/091/793/59a2365c36c77fcc5539648bed10dbe3_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1693207638&gif-q=50&q=92&s=f155c4a703628d6f6cebb6313cb24b32[/img]

[h1]Oops we did it again... 84 new auras![/h1]
So... yes we have added [b]84 new Auras to the game[/b] with a lot of new Astral ones. To better enjoy them we have also [b]increased the drop chances of Astral Auras[/b] because we think they were too rare and that it's fun to be able to build around them from early game.

We tried to create fun Astral Auras, we [b]re-used some effects from Common Spells for a few Astral Auras[/b] making you build [b]chain-reaction builds with impressive visuals[/b]!

These new Auras greatly increase build potentials and most of them require you to create builds around them and do not work by themselves which works perfectly with the increased drop chances.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/053/554/4fef57adab7641a4490f52aedcb47aa4_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1692866496&gif-q=50&q=92&s=f24878ab0e74732bf269880be482c257[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/053/556/cce7c48c8e5467f01a0ed3adec022469_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1692866522&gif-q=50&q=92&s=672a1231927ac8e2cfb841d1cea994ac[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/053/557/a1906ebb0c9bd54d953a73da58e38c05_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1692866535&gif-q=50&q=92&s=2cefa1e251d781d816a0188b65e5d39c[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/053/559/ee2238d68c1b3c45d7957c7b39633537_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1692866546&gif-q=50&q=92&s=4255cd14b9bd6d5d38244fc31d93f76a[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/091/739/132f21ef38259b4e82ebba80b7a1b673_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1693207236&gif-q=50&q=92&s=a2628401cc9f4eead2e67dcaf4c6e056[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/053/569/d2ceca314478662eb8f6254d475f2f55_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1692866608&gif-q=50&q=92&s=0ba346b12ff435623b674824d1245b51[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/091/736/c3a62b9303a3b928cda6f919911c7ef4_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1693207210&gif-q=50&q=92&s=4b74623a4b7fc0d988dbf40830f3703f[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/091/738/a8edf5f9bb996b3b1c46e9888918dc3b_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1693207222&gif-q=50&q=92&s=d35fb0bbe5cff1989a2fff29c0382dd4[/img]

We are also making a lot of progress on Final Release and we are going super big for it, we cannot wait to show you all surprises we are working on!

As always we hope you enjoy this update, if you do don't hesitate to leave us a Steam review, [b]we are getting very close of the 1000 reviews[/b] which was our objective before Final Release! ✨

Have a great day and upcoming week-end,

- The Hibernian Workshop Team

notes.title: Ayla Figure + Next Update Sneak Peek
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Last month we released the [b]Path of Destinies Update[/b] which received such a great reception, so many of you kept playing the game much more than any previous updates! 

About previous Update, community member Andreiyutzzzz already beat Destiny Level 45 which we thought would take much longer to happen. We are sure DL 54 will fall at some point!

[b]Next Update will be coming late August and it will be about Summons and other things.
[/b]
But First -- 

[h1]Ayla Figure & Backer Statues[/h1]
We received our first [b]Ayla Figure figures from Limited Run Games[/b] and they are [b]absolutely splendid[/b]! It was a real challenge with Key Art by [url=https://boello.art/]Boell Oyino[/url], sculpting by [url=https://www.graphigaut.fr/sculpture/]Graphigaut[/url] and manufacturing by [url=https://limitedrungames.com/]Limited Run Games[/url]. We are really happy about how it turned out! 

Here are pictures,  a 360 video and a video showing the box that you will receive!
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/706/951/b415612eeae6ca83f302d81cc4ccfdbd_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1690102194&gif-q=50&q=92&s=8663e4003b3c9e00ffe574682b206e41[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/706/952/bb75bf6f79689feb033928698a7ad434_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1690102205&gif-q=50&q=92&s=2ab73a55fa23319d369c832c271cd1d3[/img]
[previewyoutube=1s2TxyikNlI;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=oJm8v70NquY;full][/previewyoutube]

We will soon close our [url=https://astral-ascent.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders#store]Backerkit Store[/url] where you can pre-order the figure so hurry up if you want one!

[b]Backers statues are going to disappear even sooner from the [url=https://astral-ascent.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders#store]Backerkit Store[/url], so if you want your portrait in the Pantheon, this is last call![/b]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/707/553/678b67fc6f40f6327b55b6248fae8e6d_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1690112993&gif-q=50&q=92&s=d0cf86f1bb8b47dff2ef26e5695c9760[/img]

[h1]Next Update Preview
[/h1]One of the main elements of next Update is the summons. We are going to add effects to summons so they can be part of your builds -
[list]
[*] Taurus - Spirit Swords
[*] Pisces - Ice Swords
[*] Kiran - Embers
[*] Calie - Plasma Portals
[*] etc.
[/list]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/707/663/835abdd700d446ff66fca97b109c0753_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1690114944&gif-q=50&q=92&s=30820ed50ab6381b4c64f1d4c7eccf6a[/img]
We are also [b]going to add many new Echoes, from 15 to 31[/b] and most of them are super fun to use!
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/707/665/4d09b3d17ce67d39768dbe89ddc91600_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1690114960&gif-q=50&q=92&s=fbefecb996bd4cc97ce0d1e57eb198bc[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/707/666/d0718900cd02863ee18dc98cb6ca9290_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1690114977&gif-q=50&q=92&s=3470d0b982a6b04ef9e3e1d8dbf9e35e[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/707/668/3850d05cf8d6c792d5ee51c97ca3d50f_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1690114998&gif-q=50&q=92&s=47c211391dc0f1a7c6ac9d892bed555f[/img]

We have also [b]changed the preview of Echoes[/b] so you can identify them faster in the Echo Isles and [b]went from a choice among 3 Echoes to a choice among 4 Echoes[/b] so you are more likely to find what you are looking for.
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/707/660/047efc095eb1ee454f8d27ac183f98e0_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1690114921&gif-q=50&q=92&s=ccfd7fe4ecbbbd37de1a005ad5195ede[/img]

We have more things planned for this incoming Update, including [b]adding the system linked to the Telescop[/b] you may have noticed in the Garden.

On the other hand we are working on the final release version and it is going to be worth the wait! [b]We really went as big as possible for the final boss[/b]! 

[b]Narration is also a very big topic for us for the final release[/b], we want to find nice endings for each stories and we have changed some elements, added variations, created new types of conversations (for example heroes now have discussions with other heroes but there is many other new things).

Finally we have also [b]started reworking game introduction and creating a new tutorial[/b] for the game.

These elements should only be available for final release but at least you know a bit more what is going on behind the scene.

Oh and we received Steamdeck compatible verification!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/9604a2a1c0f6788d6fbf1ecce04a9acdeed6141b.png[/img]

Thanks again for your continuous support!

Have a great day and see you next month for the Update!

- The Hibernian Workshop Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - June 2023 - 0.46
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/6242ded5473885a37513cb08a5f0e84b1dacae9e.gif[/img]

⭐[i][b]Changes inspired by our community![/b][/i]

[h2]Small Features[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ Pavo's Feathers from Void Catalyst improvement are now further in Intro Rooms so you don't miss them
[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ Andromeda's Challenges now give drink for both players in co-op
[hr][/hr][*]Life Crusher - Does not decrease player max life when taking damage on Pavo's ruins anymore.
[hr][/hr][*]We added back the Sun pieces multiplier triggered by increasing Destiny Level in NG+ runs.
[hr][/hr][*]World 2 Magma Golem Destiny Level explosion attack would keep hitting after a long time preventing player to go back hitting the golem
[/list]
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Curse of the Blacksmith - Negative Gambits on spells went from -50% to -30% damage and from 50% chances per tier to 25% chances per tier
[hr][/hr][*]Used Pockets - from -10 quartz per tier to -5
[hr][/hr][*]Inflation : from +25% per tier of Itinerant Peddler items prices to +15% per tier
[hr][/hr][*]Shield Foes - Enemies now have 50% chances to have Armor instead of 100% and Spawned monsters by Wooden Guardian and Giant Snake can never have armor points
[hr][/hr][*]Wooden Guardian laser shoots delay is slightly more important in Destiny Level 1+
[hr][/hr][*]Harassing Foes - From 30% chances per tier to 8% chances per tier and duration from 8 secs to 6 secs
[hr][/hr][*]Vampiric Foes - from 20% per tier for regular enemies to 10%
[hr][/hr][*]Thorny Foes - From 10% per tier to 2% and timer between Thorns on enemies from 3 secs to 6 secs
[hr][/hr][*]Vengeful Foes -  From 10% per tier to 2% and timer between Dark Missiles on enemies from 3 secs to 6 secs
[hr][/hr][*]Increase all heroes basic attacks base damage and fall attack base damage for better scaling
[hr][/hr][*]Spirit friends - Added one more stack to enable 1 additional Echo on start of a run and balanced prices. This ability should also assign different echo for players during co-op.
[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ It's possible to salvage loots from Yalee Kingdom now
[hr][/hr][*]Random Echos in Void Catalyst from 1 tier at 30 to 2 tiers at 10 and 20
[hr][/hr][*]First Strike from Void Catalyst from +200% dmg to full life enemies to +300%
[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ Added a bit more time for Sagittarius to attack after her DL 6 attack
[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ Leo DL6 Spin Attack jump jump height has been reduced and now requires players to be further than before
[hr][/hr][*]Sixth Sense - from +50% to +100% to Critical Damage 
[hr][/hr][*]Shadow Clones - This malice should not cause spawn of clones too on early in runs or worlds.
[/list]
[h2]Level Design[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Removed 2 jumping crystals from an Exploration room that were conflicting with fights
[hr][/hr][*]Removed a spawn area that conflicted with jump crystals
[/list]
[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Changed ""Activate"" to ""Beat"" in Path of Destinies interface for locked elements for less confusion
[hr][/hr][*]Smoothed some Void Catalyst text descriptions
[hr][/hr][*]Barbecue UI description would become invisible if you move to right while on most right element (same for all directions)
[hr][/hr][*]There is now a input to completely reset all currencies committed in the Void Catalyst.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ Oloon Shield had a typo
[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ Removed FX from Void Catalyst that could be causing FPS drop for some players
[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ Being hit while being invincible (shield for example) during a Zodiac fight will consider you did not perfect the boss and deny the achievement
[hr][/hr][*]Apparition Sound of Shadow Clones was not playing
[/list]

- The Hibernian Workshop Team

[/list]

This Update [b]adds more than 150h to the game[/b] for those wanting more challenges and it [b]keeps the progression you made[/b] in previous Early Access version! There is a lot to share and won't be able to cover everything in this News post but here are the main things you may want to know -

[h1]Path of Destinies[/h1]
We released Astral Ascent in Early Access back in April 2022 (feels like forever ago...) with a system named the Path of Destinies allowing you to keep playing the game with an increasing difficulty. Everytime you would defeat a Zodiac in a difficulty you didn't defeat them in yet, you would receive a Destiny Fragment, an unique currency that would not allow you to buy anything and the maximum Destiny Level was 12, at each level you would need to select from 1 to 3 maluses and keep going as much as you could.

Basically only a few very talented players succeed to beat Destiny Level 12 with only motivation to overcome a very hard difficulty (and to get a bit more Sun Pieces to spend in Zim-Zim shop).
[url=https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/456/311/5ad80ceebb29676733ee56471d45d985_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1688049017&gif-q=50&q=92&s=0db0b89fde106f75dff31024e86d8129][img][/img][/url]
Path of Destinies rework main objectives were :
[list]
[*] Interesting - each element has to have an interesting effect
[*] Easy to understand
[*] Accessible start
[*] Hard end
[/list]
You [b]now have 54 Destiny Levels instead of 12[/b], you need to [b]success[/b] (beat Libra or Aquarius for now) [b]the 6 first Destiny Level to progress to next one[/b]. The 6 first ones being :  
[list][*] Destiny Level 1 -     
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/456/314/a87392228c8183e13c1a5fd8135e7305_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1688049042&gif-q=50&q=92&s=27468d6138c7a086d098a412c375fbd4[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/456/315/ff75ce6c45a2afd21a7e1b29ed4bb167_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1688049054&gif-q=50&q=92&s=8dc631d82b3e085e87dab0ddd580e912[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/456/317/bab01e1a127d22637468ce5df893d13d_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1688049068&gif-q=50&q=92&s=b3721f71b0db94b6d61dccb81f494ed5[/img]
[*] Destiny Level 2 - 
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/456/324/4c30344877f48266b8972e58ac7e3e93_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1688049097&gif-q=50&q=92&s=a4671a2c5823bdd3cbde8794a548ef50[/img]  
[*] Destiny Level 3 -    
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/456/328/9ca3302cb29fac7ee15994ef3c6f89a3_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1688049114&gif-q=50&q=92&s=0bc92623e59b4f1bee512f707945ddd4[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/456/335/a431854dfbb9b5e950cf2bc1de6f2ff8_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1688049130&gif-q=50&q=92&s=74d68cac214b3c3722c9e398687ffdf5[/img]
[*] Destiny Level 4 -   
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/456/340/9a24be440db7d1e7a8e3faf6ceeb63b4_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1688049145&gif-q=50&q=92&s=ad6887232155446fe0f9e9b1dd87cabc[/img]
[*] Destiny Level 5 -   
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/456/344/0f2899d28851d866948894d35b8ff9e1_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1688049157&gif-q=50&q=92&s=6fb2a2d913ce889dbdf07809d4b417cd[/img]
[*] Destiny Level 6 -    
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/456/346/9379439b80e32b4e1158455d38c8afe3_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1688049174&gif-q=50&q=92&s=897c67f820a622003f09177134b33d28[/img]
