notes.title: Patch Notes - December 2022 - 0.38.4
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/6242ded5473885a37513cb08a5f0e84b1dacae9e.gif[/img]

⭐[i][b]Changes inspired by our community![/b][/i]

[h2]Major Features[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Sun/Moon room cost adjustement: [/b]We changed the way sun and moon rooms work, now both the Sun and the Moon room will cost you MAX HP to enter, the only difference between the two rooms will be the spell pool.
In future updates, we intend to split the zodiac spells pool in two to have some zodiac spells exclusive to sun room and the others exclusive to moon room.
We also adjusted the cost to enter the moon room from 100 in every world to:
-50 HP in World  1
-75 HP in World 2
-100 HP inWorld 3
[hr][/hr][*][b]Signature spells - Replace the Utility spells: [/b]Each hero will now start the game with a unique Signature spell, this system completely replace the old utility spell system that we removed from the game.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Level Up system: [/b]This new system will allow you to make use of the XP gained during a run, it will now improve your character, every level granting an additional 20 HP and 15% more damage on your basics attacks.
Every level will also give you a new perk choice that will improve your basic attacks and signature spell giving it new unique properties.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Andromeda's trials - New puzzle rooms!: [/b]Added new Andromeda's trials, they are unique puzzle room focus entirely on platforming skills instead of combat as it was something missing in the game until now! Completing those trials will grant you one of the famous rainbow drinks from Andromeda!
[/list]
[h2]Small Features[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Affinty gambit context tutorial: [/b]Added a small tutorial the first time you equip a gambit with an affinity.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Ayla/Kiran summon trigger on Signature spell cast: [/b]With the new signature spell system, we made it so Ayla and Kiran summon are triggered on signature spell cast like Octave summon.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Zim-Zim ability change: [/b]We removed the Zim-Zim ""Bonus loot on intro room"" ability and replaced it with a new ability that gives you reroll possibility for the new level up perks!
[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ Sounds now work for the second player in Remote play together.
[/list]
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Enemies Power and HP balancing: [/b]The power of and HP of Enemies of the red barrens and the coral archipelago have been readjusted to overal be weaker.
[hr][/hr][*][b]XP Gain from enemies has been buffed: [/b]You will now gain more Xp from defeating enemies overall, this change was made to make the progression of the new level up system smoother
[hr][/hr][*][b]XP required to level up Hub levels has been adjusted: [/b]The price per level has been adjusted, you will now need more XP BUT Xp gain in run has been improved so overall progression shouldn't feel too different than before.
[hr][/hr][*]Nerf damage output of Octave spell ""Laceratio"".
[hr][/hr][*]Reduced Capricorn ultimate Cooldown time to 40 seconds instead of 60.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Life stone nerf: [/b]Reduce Max HP given by lifestone to 15 instead of 25.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Life Boost aura nerf: [/b]Reduce mMax HP given by the life boost aura from 100 to 50.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Virgo summon nerf: [/b]Nerfed the damage output of Virgo summon to match the rest of the Zodiacs summon
[hr][/hr][*]Reduced the chances for elites to get the gravity orb effect as it is quiet deadly compared to other effects.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Sun/Moon room spawn rate changes: [/b]We made it so every run you'll get at least 1 Sun or Moon room spawn to give you a better access to the unique zodiacs spells.

notes.title: New Exporter Update & Andromeda's Trials! 🪄
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

After the launch of the [b]Coral Archipelago Update [/b]we immediatly started working on the next major one: the [b]Crimson Highlands Update[/b]. This upcoming one will make possible to visit the 4th world with the most dangerous Zodiacs as long as playing [b]Calie, the Geomancer[/b]. 

We have already made great progress on this update and we should be able to r[b]elease it early Q1 2023[/b]. But do not worry, we will take our time to polish it as much as we did for all previous updates. We will share more about the Crimson Highlands Update in next newsletter as we have exciting news to share in this one!

[h1]New Exporter & new Systems available!💪[/h1]
Once again we had ambitious & promising new features ideas for the next upate but instead of releasing everything at once as we did for the Coral Archipelago Update, we decided to [b]release part of it for you to play right now on Steam![/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/3651886500302273659]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/3651886500302273659[/url]
[i]Game should display version 0.38.0 or higher on main menu, you can relaunch Steam if it's not.[/i]

This new content is getting available alongside [b]the long awaited New Exporter version[/b] provided by our partner [url=https://mp2.dk/][b]MP2 Games[/b][/url] and we would like to thank them again for the tremendous work porting the whole Astral Ascent game from our game engine to C++ for the best [b]possible performances[/b]!

This new exporter[b] fixes a lot of crashes and issues[/b] (like [b]Steam Remote sound issue[/b]) & massively improves FPS allowing you to play at constant frame rate with [b]almost no loadtimes[/b]. 

[b]This new version will change your game experience[/b] by making it much more comfortable and fluid, in particular for smaller settings. [b]The game is also now playable for Steamdeck[/b] with very stable 60fps, you can even do Remote Play co-op with 2 Steamdecks without issues.
 
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/403/810/41726684948800221d0d0f3345d2ab5c_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1670336866&gif-q=50&q=92&s=d066432dfc09bebc48f10f6250c03b91[/img]

However expect some inconsistencies [i](badly oriented elements, small visual glitches etc.)[/i] as this build is very close but is not yet the same as the main build, we are still working on it! 
If you see anything wrong please let us know on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/PAMkVzjSxb]Discord Server[/url] in the [b]#bugs-report channel[/b].

[h1]Level up system is the answer!✨[/h1]
[list]
[*]  [b]Basic attacks issue -[/b] Basic attacks do not become more powerful with time unlike your spells with levels & gambits so the more you progress the weaker your basic attacks feel and are. Also, getting Auras for your basic attacks was preventing you to have Auras for other purposes so you would sometimes sacrifice interesting builds to get them.
[*]  [b]Utility Spells issue -[/b] Utility spells were very inconsistent as it was rare (and occasionally too frequent) to get one. Sometimes they were strong, sometimes they were too weak and it was easy to forget to use them as they were not really part of our build.
[/list]

From these questions emerged [b]new systems[/b]

[list]
[*]  [b]Signature spells -[/b] They [b]completely replace the Utility Spells[/b] that we removed from the game, they are [b]new and unique spells based on cooldown different for each Hero[/b].  You will have many synergies to discover and play with from one run to another as you can improve them with the Level up system!
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/404/393/a549d769d5edd180f77a16629a97fb90_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1670341299&gif-q=50&q=92&s=fdbfc2f3fa7d743d048fae1a0eaaa508[/img]
[i]Kiran signature spell is "Parry then Punch!", making you temporary invincible! [/i]

[*]  [b]Level up system - [/b]Defeating enemies will now grant you experience points, filling an experience bar  above your HP, when it reaches a certain threshold, your character will level up gaining [b]maximum Health, Basic attacks damage[/b] and the possibility to [b]claim a Prowess[/b]. 
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/403/996/3232842835cba1109d4305bd07b574ae_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1670338119&gif-q=50&q=92&s=ad516c54c04a9d2aa31131a944b22d9e[/img]
[i]Octave, level 7 with 9/40 xp points to level 8[/i]


[*]  [b]The Prowesses -[/b] They are a set of passive skills that can be claimed in intro rooms of each world, including first world, when interacting with the giants there. Every level, you will be able to claim 1 additional prowess to a max of 8 in a run. These prowesses are of two kinds: Basic attack (right) & Signature Spell (left)
[/list]
 
[previewyoutube=G8rzcxeMjWs;full][/previewyoutube]

[b] The Prowesses for Signature spells are unique to each hero[/b], there is a lot to try out! Also, Zim-Zim now has an ability to make you reset the choices of Prowesses.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/404/404/26f83eee60a434e7014d60f1926c05d9_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1670341353&gif-q=50&q=92&s=08956f414e5ee90c5b15f76b9b75f42a[/img]
[i]Ayla's signature spell "Shadow Mark" (teleports behind enemies) with reset on kill Prowess[/i]


[h1]Andromeda's trials! 🧩[/h1]
Another fun addition to the game are the [b]Andromeda's trials![/b]

In the [b]exploration rooms[/b], sometimes you will find a [b]purple altar[/b], interacting with them will teleport you to a new room where you will have to face a platforming challenge without being hit to get one of the famous [b]rainbow drinks poured by Andromeda herself[/b]! 

Do not worry, [b]if you get hit you are simply teleported outside[/b] but you will not lose HP so feel free to try them as many times as you want! We personally love them and we hope you will too!
 
[previewyoutube=lYw_qrMIdhg;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[h1]Discord trading card game!🃏[/h1]
A smaller addition has been made to the Discord server, the [b]Astral Ascent Digital Trading Card game[/b]!

[b]Every day Barbecue offers you a new card from his fine collection[/b]! You can trade them with everyone or merge them to gain rarer cards (4 rarities for the 39 existing cards) and get the greatest collection!


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/318/424/92e0035b14a91c47f9f8b650a3b188e8_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1669367901&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=5ea6d50efbdc7eecef1d969a304ff2da[/img]
[i]Hop on our discord to get a card whenever you want![/i]
 
There was no newsletter last month but be sure we are working our hardest to make the game the best it can be and we are still active on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/PAMkVzjSxb]Discord Server[/url] for any of your suggestions and feedback!
 
Oh, and here are [b]some extra elements[/b]!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/413/105/c406d3cefb0798a9504f517ffb352592_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1670430885&gif-q=50&q=92&s=02ddb7f132a194fddfb91bce10dc3f7e[/img]
[i]We added a Glossary that you can check anytime while ingame![/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/404/752/d83ff80e5de6e6dd2a6b722f6781c73a_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1670343752&gif-q=50&q=92&s=90a95daa0914b2b3215b10619b513c10[/img]
[i]Merchants culture is ancient and not very well known but they remember it through these statues[/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/404/759/f2a18991cc042e74fd8ad5a551388b06_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1670343785&gif-q=50&q=92&s=29653ee36690bc7a13d30fcf06d820de[/img]
[i]Oloon wanted her place to feel more precious as you can imagine[/i]

More improvements are coming later!

Don't forget our [url=https://astral-ascent.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders#store]Backerkit shop[/url] and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/PAMkVzjSxb]Discord Server [/url]to speak with the community and give us feedbacks on the game!

 
Have an excellent week ahead and next time we will share about the upcoming world 4!

The Hibernian Workshop Team

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/318/440/638fca76ecc47f85bb164acca9a6a2c7_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1669368074&gif-q=50&q=92&s=1608b688996b7ca768a6f04d6c7906f7[/img]

notes.title: The Coral Archipelago Update is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[h1]Play a new Character, explore a new World, fight new Zodiacs and much more![/h1]

[previewyoutube=yDI7BKN4YGQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks a lot everyone for your patience regarding this Update, we created so much more elements than we originally anticipated in order to [b]create the best and most complete experience possible for this first Major Update[/b] ([i]several more to come![/i]).

This version sadly does not contain the new exporter that will solve many crashes and increase performances by a lot (if you have performances issue, don't hesitate to[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1280930/discussions/0/3272436686701232011/ ] check this guide[/url]). We have made huge progress on it but this new exporter still contains issues so we thought it would be better to release it once it is totally ready but you can [b]expect it to be released Q4 2022[/b], take a look at our Roadmap iff you want more precisions about it. This version also does not have a complete localization to supported languages yet, when translations are missing it should be replaced by English for now, we will update when we have receive the texts.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/3328745165985235930

For the next weeks we will be working on solving the main bugs/balancing issues that you will encounter so do not hesitate to report these on our [url=http://discord.gg/hibernian-workshop][b]Discord Server [/b][/url] where we have dedicated channels for that. We will also start preparing the mid W3-W4 Update.

If you want a complete list of what is new, here is our [b]complete Patch Notes link[/b] and the main features listed below - 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/5009714462577553599

[h2]Major Features[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]New Playable Character - Octave: [/b]New range hero with 11 unique spells to unlock
[hr][/hr][*][b]New World to Explore - The Coral Archipelago: [/b]New assets, new traps and new enemies
[hr][/hr][*][b]New Zodiacs Battles: [/b]Scorpio & Pisces. Face these 2 members of the Orphnée family
[hr][/hr][*][b]Scorpio & Pisces challenges: [/b]Get their summons through their challenges
[hr][/hr][*][b]Sun Room: [/b]Exchange your quartz to access powerful spells
[hr][/hr][*][b]Moon Room: [/b]Exchange your maximum life to access Zodiac unique powers
[hr][/hr][*][b]Zodiac Spells: [/b]Find and use 7 news powerful zodiac spells: Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn, Sagittarius, Leo, Pisces and Scorpio
[hr][/hr][*][b]Echo Isles Room & Summon your Friends: [/b]Pick among 15 different summons of your friends so they can help you during your run
[hr][/hr][*][b]New Miniboss - Draco: [/b]Fight a dangerous new Miniboss
[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ [b]Andromeda's bar interior: [/b]Visit the Zodiacs there and the more victory you have against them, the more likely they are to join you
[hr][/hr][*][b]Affinity Zodiac: [/b]Your Constellation sign can now randomly help you (once you met at least once) and will more easily join you in Andromeda's bar
[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ [b]Pixel Art Animated Portraits: [/b]Legacy Portraits will still be accessible through game options but default portraits will now be Pixel Art and hand-animated
[hr][/hr][*][b]Fight Rooms Rework: [/b]Complete rework in order to have waves / difficulty depending of level of the room 
[hr][/hr][*][b]New Affinity System: [/b]Spells now have elemental affinities (fire/ice/thunder/poison and neutral) and they gain power with related elemental gambits attached (up to 100% bonus damage)

notes.title: Astral News - August 2022
notes.notes:
[h1]September it is! 🌅[/h1]
We have a release date for the World 3 update named "[b]The Coral Archipelago Update[/b]", this release date is in [b]September 2022[/b], which means we are only a few weeks away from releasing a game changer update for [b]Astral Ascent[/b]. 
We know this update has been very long to release but [b]we added much more than we anticipated to the game[/b]. 

[b]A world update is supposed to contain -[/b]
[list]
[*] A new playable character (Octave for this one that comes with 11 unique spells)
[*] A new world to explore (+ 8 new enemies and 4 level design elements)
[*] 2 new Zodiacs + their challenges and summons
[*] World 4 Zodiac blocking your path
[/list]
[b]In addition to that we added -[/b]
[list]
[*] Zodiacs Spells system (it means 7 of them already)
[*] Reworked some existing Zodiac summons
[*] Sun & Moon new room type
[*] New mini-boss - Draco (whose fighting style might remind you of someone!)
[*] Kinship System & Echoes Room, you can have up to 4 friends to summon by your side from a total of 15 possible summons (Zim-Zim, Oloon, Ikki, Ordan, the Heroes and much more)
[*] Pantheon room accessible for those who paid an ingame statue of themselves (with or without their pets)
[*] Andromeda's bar interior with new friendship system with the Zodiacs that will make chosing your constellation meaningful (this is not final yet but close to what we had in mind)
[*] Major synergy rework that will make your runs much more interesting with many new or reworked auras, gambits, effects
[*] One more complicated and very requested element is still unannounced ✨
[/list]

But that's not all as we have also [b]improved so many small details all around[/b], from small UI improvement, to enemies AI and balancing, about everything has been closely looked and observed to be improved (even the Credits screen has been reworked!), at least we did our very best given the small team that we are.

That being said, there is one major element for this update that we took the decision to postpone. It is the [b]New Exporter[/b] named "Chowdren" version. The game is already playable on this version but there is many small elements that are not as polished as they are on the regular version. It is really sad for us to delay this version as [b]it changes about everything -[/b]
[list]
[*] Game is running incredibly faster
[*] Many crashes are solved
[*] Remote Play Together sound problem should be solved too
[*] Loading times are feeling inexistant (as you can see on below video)
[/list]
 
[previewyoutube=gudI_-Dc6mM;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=zQcjvT_MatM;full][/previewyoutube]

But Astral Ascent is a massive project and it takes time for our partner  to solve all the small issues and we currently do not know when exactly this new version will be ready and instead of keep delaying the world 3 update we decided to delay the Chowdren version and make it live as soon as it will be as good as the main version of the game so [b]you can expect a small update between world 3 and world 4 updates with this optimized version and hopefully some more exciting elements[/b] (we already have some ideas). Our goal is to avoid impacting too much the world 4 release period that should take less time for the world 3 one. 

Rest assured that our porting partner is doing an incredible job and the project could not be in better hands, new version will be worth the wait! 

[h1]Affinity system! 🧊[/h1]
Continuing with the new effects and synergies that we created for this update, we added a final touch - The [b]Affinity System[/b]. This system will give you a way to make you spells even stronger by [b]having certains type of gambits on it corresponding to the element of the spell[/b].
When you equip a gambit on a spell with an elemental affinity that is the same as the gambit, the spell will gain an increased percentage of bonus damage dealt on hit.
 
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/038/431/306/4a7289ac46651dee03337dcfdf972cee_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1661852440&gif-q=50&q=92&s=6a3eb15d83ea09ffee26e4de747b405e[/img]
[i]Spell with fire affinity + fire gambits[/i]

However even if that is very clear that Magma Comets have a fire affinity,  some spells do not seem to match a specific affinity like the Spirit Sword below, but don't worry! These spells are considered to have a neutral affinity, instead of having no affinity they actually have an affinity with every gambits but with a lesser increased bonus damage percentage. 
To make things more open we have decided to make specific spells like Fireballs to be randomly neutral and for some spells like Ayla's shuriken to randomly have any affinity type. We think that is yet another very exciting change to the synergy system as it creates even more strategy when equiping spells & gambits.
 
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/038/431/316/f121b6eeaab7d767252825659d2bbdfc_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1661852513&gif-q=50&q=92&s=783bb1c52a1f5de0cc2089394a124915[/img]
[i]Spell with neutral affinity + any gambit[/i]

[h1]New zodiacs challenges! ♏[/h1]
Expect [b]new challenges to come[/b] with this update! 2 new challenges made for Scorpio & Pisces, the new Zodiacs. Even if Scorpio is really mean, he would be a very powerful ally to have by your side to escape the Garden!
 
[previewyoutube=1sSivCGw0Zg;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[h1]Kinship system is done! 🐺[/h1]
The new kinship system is finally done! Your friends from The Garden will now be able to help you in your journey. You can find exclusive "[b]Echoes[/b]" in the Echoes Room that will grant you an [b]unique ability related to one of your friends[/b].   Enjoy some of those new summons effects!
 
 [previewyoutube=ruCJyyw72uM;full][/previewyoutube]
[i] Ikki can save you once per world! [/i]
 
[previewyoutube=-6eb2R1yVLA;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Ordan will give a piece of her mind to the Zodiacs you will face.[/i]
 
[previewyoutube=-tN_Xy6HyyY;full][/previewyoutube]
[i] Other heroes like Kiran will also come to your help! [/i]

[h1]Old visual effects rework! ✨[/h1]
With all the polish going on, we took time to redo some of the older visual effects of the game to make them look even cooler and cleaner than before. Have a glimpse!
 
[previewyoutube=-NMBhZvTpTk;full][/previewyoutube]
 
We have very excited to release the update, [b]see you in September[/b]!

Don't forget our [url=https://astral-ascent.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders#store]Backerkit shop[/url] and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/PAMkVzjSxb]Discord Server[/url] to speak with the community and give us feedbacks on the game!

[i]Hardworking team[/i]
 
Have a nice week!
-The Hibernian Workshop Team

notes.title: Astral News - July 2022
notes.notes:
This entire month has been dedicated to finishing all the ongoing features. This is a very ambitious update that we are working on, here are some recent news about it.

[h2]New Effects, Gambits and Auras: the Synergy rework🔥[/h2]
We were not entirely satisfied with the Gambits, Effects and Auras that we had in the game. We knew the system was very interesting but when creating builds we felt it always lacked -[b] Synergy.[/b] 

[i]What we call Synergy is the possible combinaisons between the different playable elements that you can find in the game - Spells, Gambits, Auras, Effects.[/i]

We had the feeling that very few synergies existed and it was mainly about multi-hit spells and mono-hit spells. After a lot of design talks, we improved the system and made [b]many changes to improve it and make it more central to the game progression[/b].

- First, [b]we removed many of the Auras and Gambits that were not very interesting to play with[/b], for example the ones dealing more damages if enemy health is full or depending of number of effects affecting the enemies. 

- Second, [b]we added several new unique effects to create more synergies[/b] opportunities between your spells, auras and gambits! What we call Effects are elements negatively affecting enemies, we have also reworked the way Effects stacks are displayed above enemies as you can see below.

[previewyoutube=xd_7BqI8avM;full][/previewyoutube]

 
We also added some [b]new summons[/b] that will trigger Effects, here are some for you to enjoy!
[previewyoutube=YlSIfAjjl3Q;full][/previewyoutube]


A feeling that we had in game for a while was the feeling of [b]not really choosing your build[/b] regarding the gambits you equip on your spell, here are some balancing changes according to this.
Spells will now always come with at least [b]2 gambit slot available minimum[/b]. 
Gambit slot unlocker cost has been reduced from 200 to 75 quartz to be a lot more affordable.

- Finally we also [b]reworked all the Gambits icons and Aura icons[/b] to have a more [b]distinct personality[/b] and be much more clearer.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/038/110/947/877f79396c23961f156c57f1d65a1f24_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1659100462&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=9d5e042b601a452e2d4bd7110601afab[/img]

[i]Some of the new Auras Icons[/i]
 

[h2]The coral archieplago progress 🏝️[/h2]
[b]The coral archipelago content is now complete[/b]! All the new enemies have been done and will now enter polish phase. Here's a quick tease of what you'll be facing in the world.
[previewyoutube=t79yTlufYuQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Dale has also came through this month with the [b]new great theme of the 3rd world[/b], enjoy a glimpse!
[previewyoutube=x8iUxL7dwSU;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Andromeda's bar interior progress 🍹[/h2]
Now that the bar interior is open, you will be able to [b]meet the zodiac there in a more peaceful context[/b], discussing with them and if you're lucky they might even consider joining you in battle!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/038/109/623/0b928ee146229bb0c3459df487ed462f_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1659089639&auto=format&frame=1&q=92&s=ed22ed03d3826ca08e78e430d7fdeb0b[/img]
[i]Taurus agrees to help you![/i]
 
A [b]Jukebox[/b] is also available inside for you to enjoy the game ost!
[previewyoutube=lJ0AfeB0ZMI;full][/previewyoutube]
 

[h2]Elites visual rework 💀[/h2]
Another system that got a visual rework are the [b]elites enemies[/b]. They now have an all new color palette applied to them to really feel like different enemies! We also reworked the UI to have icons above their head instead of a text for a better visibility.
 
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/038/101/666/5b71de0be49f1e1cd3d32e8135f80a99_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1659025784&auto=format&frame=1&q=92&s=13762d8c851d5916eec872355e86fae7[/img]

[h2]Finally a small gameplay glimpse of Octave 🎯[/h2]
Keeping you updated with [b]Octave[/b], here's a [b]small gameplay clip[/b] of some possible combos between his spells, enjoy!
[previewyoutube=k2slCavtN20;full][/previewyoutube]


We are entering a [b]critical  phase for the next update[/b], for now we prefer to not give a precise release date for this update as we do not want to compromise on quality.

Don't forget our Backerkit shop and our Discord Server to speak with the community and give us feedbacks on the game!

Hard working team

notes.title: Astral Update - June 2022
notes.notes:
Happy  to report this month the team has made huge progress on all the new content for the next update and soon all that will be left to do is polish and playtest! ✨

So, without further ado, here is our progress report - 


[h1]Welcome to the Coral Archipelago! 🌊[/h1]
The next world is here! The islands are waiting for you to cross them and meet the marine fauna! [b]But be careful[/b], this world is the home of the dangerous [b]Noble Zodiacs[/b], fierce enemies that will never allow you to pass without an intense fight!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/773/842/be0c8eee4b347c98ad0feb275fd43772_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1656343865&gif-q=50&q=92&s=f5e641ee6f5320ec6cf52bd879d94a84[/img]
[i]The coral archipelago[/i]

[h1]The Pantheon and Ayla figure 💫[/h1]
The Pantheon is a new place accessible from the main hub of the game. When used, the floating orb will teleport you into a place where we immortalized some of our backers as golden statues. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/783/281/244bf0f11c33b79a61b0184a35f1c656_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1656409421&gif-q=50&q=92&s=5bf8e34537fada54c2a576f251029244[/img]
[i]You can access the pantheon from the village[/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/773/808/fc2366e9b53b4219c32123dfa5ca0051_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1656343759&gif-q=50&q=92&s=06232b35bb1ce37d1d1c76b39c02c3c5[/img]
[i]The Pantheon[/i]

We initially wanted to have these statues randomly spawning at the merchant's room but this way anyone can witness them directly from the main hub. If you also want to have a statue of yourself (it can be with your pet) and your name appears when standing next to the statue, you can still order it on our [url=https://astral-ascent.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders]Backerkit store[/url]. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/784/646/8b02930c746e274cd0dd61eff25a76a6_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1656418716&gif-q=50&q=92&s=01ade50b65b4582a620c4cc47eefc0c7[/img]

We also have [b]great news regarding the Ayla figure[/b] (also available on the [url=https://astral-ascent.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders]Backerkit store[/url]), Limited Run Games manufacturer produced an example version that suits our vision and we really love it - we hope you will like it as much as we do!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/784/751/84ea37003eb1eb8ee2cd17e96592aa34_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1656419225&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=d3a8979e72df2d7826c048a47d60fc60[/img]

[h1]Kinship system🤝[/h1]
A completely new system has been added to the game, the[b] kinship system[/b]!

In your runs, you will now have access to a new special room inside wich you'll get a new kind of item: [b]the souvenirs.[/b]

Souvenirs will grant you [b]the power of one (or more) of your friend(s) from the Garden[/b]! Each character has their own unique power that will surely help you through your journey!

The intent of this system was to make the characters you meet and love a bigger part of your escape attempts and feel a deeper connection to them when they join your adventure!


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/784/871/34d740dbcc2e474ca92acef98a6555f4_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1656419879&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=08d836b892c8269a947c2d17cbad526e[/img]
[i]Work in progress room[/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/783/094/ecc5789aa3267aeaa77781b1706a6c87_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1656407943&gif-q=50&q=92&s=15cec243803fd34d4a12e151616f21e4[/img]
[i]If your health is low, Zim-Zim will come to your help![/i]

Look forward to getting the souvenir as they will surely prove useful in your quest.  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/783/101/2c38c1e9556d3e3d3d4120771079a57f_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1656408005&gif-q=50&q=92&s=b98f867e854439b3d62cd02c7ef32cfd[/img]
[i]Octave combo attack[/i]

[h1]Zodiac summons rework ♍[/h1]
Another accomplishment from this month was the [b]rework of several of our Zodiac summons[/b]!

Most of the old summon either didn't fit the zodiac or were lacking in juice! So we decided to rework most of them to become truly impressive attacks!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/773/970/d34d3612f1a7c924ed857d12fd8ef37c_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1656344476&gif-q=50&q=92&s=7e82398fdd0a1d3248705653ac4888fb[/img]
[i]Virgo new summon[/i]

But that's not all [b]we also made summons for the next two A
Zodiacs[/b] of the Coral Archipelago, enjoy a sneak peek!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/774/509/6fff9d9bb84f903bbc4df4582535aeb6_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1656347145&gif-q=50&q=92&s=c5fa0280df9f00e871dd81537a0c642a[/img]
[i]Scorpio summon[/i]

[h1]New spells - the Zodiacs spells ♐[/h1]
We added a new kind of spell to the game, [b]the Zodiac spells[/b]! They'll give you the ability to use some of the [b]zodiacs signature attacks[/b] as your own.

Don't expect to find them like others  spells! They will only be accessible in a special place, but we'll let you find out for yourselves.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/782/376/ee6cd14b16ac2d32fddb9c72b36d8ac5_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1656402785&gif-q=50&q=92&s=22fd7a3995c52568f5ccab7ddb48e7fb[/img]
[i]Capricorn zodiac spell[/i]

[h1]Andromeda's bar 🥂[/h1]
[b]The door to the interior of the Andromeda's bar is now open[/b], in here you'll be able to meet the zodiacs and talk with them in a peaceful environment.

Get insight about the world by the mouth of your enemies, learn more about them and if you're lucky, they might even join you directly in your journey!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/774/000/c70cc75443247aefcf21a6a448c91b5f_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1656344593&gif-q=50&q=92&s=a9b2edd756e90946250edcc9d4c8c923[/img]
[i]Interior of Andromeda's bar[/i]

[h1]Discord new emotes! Join us! ✨[/h1]
We also did something for our lovely [url=http://discord.gg/hibernian-workshop][b]discord community[/b][/url]. New [b]Astral Ascent emotes[/b] have been added to the server for you to express yourself there or on any other place if you have Discord Nitro!


We hope you'll enjoy them as much as we do! 
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/773/744/4bfe7433cfb7b6d9b280dce3f0ca0e10_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1656343421&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=1646f3971d29d0db2c857d7afdac169f[/img]

This month has been a great month of progress and we cannot wait to let you play with all of this new content! 



Don't forget our [url=https://astral-ascent.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders#store]Backerkit shop[/url] and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/PAMkVzjSxb]Discord Server[/url] to speak with the community and give us feedbacks on the game!


Hard working team
Have a great day and week!

-The Hibernian Workshop Team

notes.title: Astral Update - May 2022
notes.notes:
First of all, we want to [b]thank everyone for making this Early Access launch so succesful[/b]! We loved watching your reactions, reading your theories and your suggestions - [b]one major of these suggestions is being developed[/b]. 

Also, if you have the occasion to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280930/Astral_Ascent/][b]leave a review on Steam[/b][/url], it helps us gain visibility and it is much appreciated!

All the team is thrilled for what's coming next and eager to give you the great experience you are looking for!

[h1]We started working on Octave! 🌠[/h1]
You are all waiting for it and, as promised, we are working on implementing a new playable character: [b]Octave the gunslinger[/b]! 
As the name suggest, he will fight at a distance using two guns and bring ethereal weapons to the battle!
We hope you'll have fun playing around with him once the update will be out!
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/417/134/1398d5ccc410cf6ad4a329d74c0266cf_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1653402050&gif-q=50&q=92&s=87a602d955f84dff1062fbad8765287b[/img]
[i]Octave the gunslinger[/i]
 
[h1]New bosses in the work! ♏[/h1]
We also made a lot of progress on the next bosses for the coral archipelago.
Scorpio beat you up again and again stopping you from going through the third world but soon you'll be able to take your revenge!
However, [b]don't expect an easy battle[/b], Scorpio may be arrogant but he has the power to back it up!
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/417/545/9229ec4f38ccce9602dd229fd6b30ea9_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1653403658&gif-q=50&q=92&s=9bcb46fdf4e1506f021b97755325565f[/img]
[i]Scorpio won't give you any slack![/i]
 
[b]A new star guardian[/b] also joined the frey: [b]Draco[/b]!
A mysterious and blazing warrior capable of incredible martial feats!
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/417/638/37681848797d76fa015fba7a36e1bc53_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1653404083&gif-q=50&q=92&s=7b55037d2f310ba788f04443aad808f3[/img]
[i]Draco is a fierce enemy![/i]
 
[h1]New Traps and Props! 🐡[/h1]
We are working hard on the coral archiepelago world and while we don't have suitable visuals to share for now, we worked on some new traps and props for this specific world inspired by the marine life.
We hope they'll be of good use in your next adventures!
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/417/729/4c14dd86f54ee40243417da3ec198dea_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1653404439&gif-q=50&q=92&s=09a94839e75fcb0b9547f2d4d70f2b2b[/img]
[i]Jelly Fish[/i]
 


We also made a big change from the W2 traps, we decided to remove the statue trap that we considered not being a good trap and replaced it by this [b]new sand shark trap[/b]! Watch where you are walking!
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/417/878/ed1037cf518ba7e052bb203399a07f7c_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1653405034&gif-q=50&q=92&s=8e063fc7dfaf73ba411e1a9aa8cb09c4[/img]
[i]Beware of the sand sharks![/i]
 
[h1]New NPC and room: The Sun ☀️ and The Moon 🌙[/h1]
Lastly for the content update, we are working on [b]additional rooms[/b] to the game inspired by the sun and the moon.

These new unique rooms will ONLY be accessible by activating a new rare altar in exploration rooms and will contain the most powerful of spell you ever saw in the game.

In the sun room, you'll have access to 3 altars selling you powerful spell for a great amount of different resources like Quartz, Stars and Keys.
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/418/316/7572ec607fed00a216792c1e08e16f0f_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1653406837&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=4be297998b097de67b6b687f974d5a9fThe sun room[/img]
[i]The sun room[/i]
 
In the moon room, you'll also have access to 3 altars selling even more powerful spell than in the sun room however you'll have to bargain with your max health to obtain them so don't get too greedy!
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/418/377/2e39dfc301d05f0ecb4a69cf47e66111_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1653407154&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=37d6623ffa94cf3899ef92479420d716Moon room[/img]
[i]Moon room[/i]
 

We're again thankful to everyone who made our Early access launch a success and we hope you are thrilled to see what's waiting for you in the [b]next update that is targeted to release for mid August[/b]!

Don't forget our Backerkit shop and our Discord Server to speak with the community and give us feedbacks on the game!
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/418/488/62969ab73d828e018f474782d13ed3be_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1653407749&gif-q=50&q=92&s=e964770fc414c5111ff169cae50d1671[/img]
Hard working team
 
Have a wonderful day,
-The Hibernian Workshop Team

notes.title: Astral Ascent - Some news from the Hibernian Workshop
notes.notes:
Dear Astral Ascent players,

First of all, we wanted to thank you for the support and the love you've sent us since the release of the Early Access. It's a huge step for us after over 3 years of work on the game and we're so happy to see how many players enjoy playing Astral Ascent. 🌟

We have received some feedbacks about crashes and bugs related to performance issues. We are really sorry about that, we know that's is a major problem right now and we are working hard to fix this: for the next major update,[b] the game will be ported with a new game exporter[/b], much more optimized than the one we're using today. This change should solve most of the issues encountered and the game should run way smoother across the board. 

While waiting for this update, we suggest you to take a look at our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1280930/discussions/0/3272436686701232011/]common issues guide[/url]. You'll find some temporary solutions to avoid crashes. 
This guide is updated each time a new solution is discovered. For example, recently, some players noticed a major performance boost by [b]installing the game on a SSD[/b]. It turns out it helps a lot of players who had performance issues. So feel free to add a comment if it doesn't work or if you find a new solution. 

If you encounter any more issues, you can join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/hibernian-workshop]Discord server[/url] and send a message in the #bug-report channel or in the thread of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1280930/discussions/0/3272436686701232011/]common issues guide[/url].

In the meantime, we are working on [b]a small update that should come in the next few weeks[/b]. Some minor changes will be made there and you'll be able to play Astral Ascent in Japanese! 


Thank you for everything and have a wonderful day,
- The Hibernian Workshop Team ✨

notes.title: Astral Update - April 2022
notes.notes:
[h1][b] Astral Ascent is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280930/Astral_Ascent/]now available on Steam Early Access[/url]! [/b][/h1]

[previewyoutube=PLVr-p3Hmx0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Let your friends and favorite content creators know about the game[/b] and don't hesitate to review the game on Steam! As we are [b]self-publishing[/b], we are even more counting on you!

The whole team has worked hard to[b] deliver the best possible 2D Rogue-lite[/b] we could create, here is what you can expect - 
[list]
[*] 2 out of the 5 playable characters
[*] 5 out of the 12 Zodiacs bosses
[*] 2 out of the 4 Worlds to explore
[*] 2 minibosses
[*] Fully Voiced dialogs
[*] New Game Plus feature
[*] Local co-op
[/list]
And this is not the end, we will provide[b] updates through the Early Access with new worlds, new Zodiacs, new playable characters and more![/b] We will also try to provide assistance on bugs and polishing.

Also, we have decided to only focus on [b]Windows during Early Access [/b]but you can expect the game to be on [b]Mac and Linux at the final release[/b].

[h1]EARLY ACCESS KEYS[/h1]
 
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/956/136/52e10433d0e1305e9585044ad4551c85_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1649714831&auto=format&frame=1&q=92&s=af530da46b998590c5d3bbda044dcaa1[/img]

 
[b]All Early Access keys have been sent by email[/b] to backers who either selected the[b] Early Access pledge[/b] level or [b]added a Steam Key as add-on[/b] to their pledges.

[b]Important note[/b] - Please check your Spams if you didn't receive your key yet, we still have more than 500 of you who received the email but did not open it, the email is named [i][b]Astral Ascent - Early Access Steam Key - Kickstarter Reward[/b][/i].

notes.title: Astral Update - March 2022
notes.notes:
[h1]Announcement video[/h1]

[previewyoutube=DbPahcF2jnY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h3]Astral Ascent is coming to Steam Early Access on April 12![/h3][/b]

The whole team would like to thank you for the great support you have given us since the Kickstarter campaign started, we are now days away from releasing our first self-published game and it means a lot to us so thank you again for making this possible. 🌟



[h1]Fully voiced[/h1]
We are so happy to tell you that we will have every dialogs voiced (English) for the  Early Access release. We have worked with insanely talented voice actors, they gave life to each character and we absolutely love the result.

[previewyoutube=epzfgcQy2k4;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]New Game Plus[/h1]
We have been hard working on the NG+ elements for some time and we were not really happy with what we had because we used to have small changes for each level. We changed that to focus on 12 levels of NG+ and each level makes a real change by making the game more fun & challenging. 

You will find elements such as :

[list]
[*] Dead enemies can revive as zombies
[*] Bosses now have elite modificators
[*] Elites are much more frequent and dangerous
[*] and much more...
[/list]
It can quickly become very hard to deal with and we cannot wait to see how far you will be able to go with this system! This system will evolve with time as we do not have all the Zodiacs in the game yet.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/837/645/69627a118788af6c1356aa250646a5b3_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1648729566&gif-q=50&q=92&s=687671ffffdc2d82d43c930d4b9e0202[/img]


Have a wonderful day and see you for the release date!


-The Hibernian Workshop Team

notes.title: Astral Update - February 2022
notes.notes:
First of all, we want to left you know that we are getting[b] closer and closer to the Early Access release date[/b], it's no longer a matter of years or months but it's [b]a matter of weeks[/b]! Yes, we are that close and we will keep you updated about it.

[h1]New Playtest version! ♉ [/h1]
This month update makes no exception, we have made many new changes into the game but the good news is that [b]you can play right now with the Playtest version[/b] ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/3113680716514300500]dedicated patch-note of this version here[/url]) ! Do not hesitate to share your feedback about the game either here or on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/PAMkVzjSxb]Discord Server[/url], this is truly helping us making the best possible game as we are currently looking for bugs, balancing and polish in order to be ready for the Early Access release.

[h1]Extra NPCs Animations[/h1]
You might remember our last Stretch Goal from the Kickstarter campaign, we were so close to get it that we decided we would work on it anyway in order to thank you for the great success of this campaign.
 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/493/272/0b29160395cab59cbe59df15c240807c_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1646043957&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=88ee6519e462e20f278ba8944573703b[/img]

 
We have already added a lot of new animations for the Garden folks, Papa Yalee even has new visuals.
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/461/193/5b94f4dceb3aecb55704fd8d3200640e_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1645716549&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=1c9dad1ae18a89009eac05e63f72c2dc[/img]
Papa Yalee likes his new cat basket
 
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/493/513/0e7d271d5db51e9178bcda355d9f8a11_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1646046195&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=87f7f6f67e1f9541f6a5888deaebabf0[/img]
Little Yalees studying potions
 
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/493/514/03c825aa1b86833cbb7fd711dd76fc31_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1646046215&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=bf578f336dad29c7e5f82c5aaadb0da2[/img]
The peddler is working on some poetry
 
These new animations make the Garden even more lively!

[h1]Spell level up! 🔮 [/h1]
We added a new progression system: the spell level system!
Spells will now have [b]a level going from 0 to 10[/b]. Each level will[b] give the spell a bonus % damage[/b], giving you the opportunity to make your favorite spells even stronger and also to make it interesting to change your builds more regularly as the [b]loot rarity increases with your run worlds progression[/b]. 
We had this idea to solve the lack of incentives to change spells once you had 4 different spells, it makes things much more dynamic and interesting in the long run. 
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/460/924/4a718dadca16189e665a053154acb70c_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1645714662&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=786e8cfd27cff06f20f83e923d734f54[/img]
Leveling up a spell.
 
This system introduces a new kind of loot: the [b]peacock feather[/b]! This is used to gain spell levels and make them more powerful, it is a [b]new room reward with gambits/spells and crystal[/b]s.
 They come in several rarities giving from +1 or +2 levels to a whooping +5 for the legendary gold feather!

[h1]2 New Constellations NPCs and rooms: Cetus 🐋 and Pavo 🦚 [/h1]
In our research of more runs variety and adding more unique Constellations NPCs (as we did with Andromeda before) we worked on 2 Constellations NPCs that come with two new rooms with unique mechanics:
 1 - [b]the Cetus room[/b]: A mysterious cave containing lots of treasures and baubles and waiting inside is not a fierce dragon but a giant whale, [b]Cetus[/b]! This friendly creature will give you a choice between several categories of gambits and will give you 2 (or sometime 3) gambits of the specified kind. Don't forget to thank the creature on your way out!
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/460/930/71ce0fd23c90eae3c20e2de92ef816ce_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1645714705&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=4f535457089b0bd7a989a561472c2c41[/img]
Cetus in the cave.
 
 2 -  [b]the Pavo room[/b]: A gorgeous sky structure that seems to be located in an entirely different world. Here, Pavo the peacock will granting you a feather to gain power from (increase spell level). If you feel greedy, you can also ask Pavo for more feather but everytime, you will need to sacrifice healthpoints to do so.
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/460/939/46b0ead60563f79f4e237e8855dc4e4c_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1645714740&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=88a72e72b0dc9562c30a8d9c7cfa6a28[/img]
Pavo in his ruins.
 
We hope you'll have fun discovering them in your next escape attempts!

[h1]Context dialog system! 🗨️ [/h1]
We worked on a new system merging narration and gameplay and come up with what we call the context dialog system!
This system is simple, in certain contexts [b]when you go through the game, characters will start talking[/b] giving you sometimes advices on what's happening or simply greeting you! 
The heroes also react dynamically in a lot of situations making the global experience more dynamic.
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/460/986/6c4798bc3eb1a55d0791ab73c9760caa_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1645714948&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=e01cc5e26776fa8abfb4932dd9ad79a5[/img]
context dialogs
 
For now the voices are made with an AI but we are actively working on making quality voice-overs with great actors for the game.

[h1]Overall bosses rework! 💪 [/h1]
We spent time to rework every bosses in the game, we've made the decision to [b]make them faster and thus harder[/b] but we [b]reworked visual feedbacks a lot to make them more readable[/b] and also changed some of their attacks. Also, even if they are harder now, you will always have an[b] healing room option before bosses [/b]so you do not start a boss fight with no chances or no possibility to better understand the patterns. Zodiacs want fair fights and so do we but [b]prepare for intense fights against those mighty warriors![/b]
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/461/131/7b6549a8ffa3c6d6e90ed206e2b23082_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1645716097&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=e13d1e07d90fc1383621d5d7cda4953f[/img]
Be ready!
 
We really hope you will appreciate all this new content we added, do not hesitate to send us feedback about it. Also, unlisted youtube videos with commented gameplay are extremely appreciated to help us understand better your reactions to the different situations. (the team speaks english, french & portuguese)

Don't forget our [url=https://astral-ascent.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders#store]Backerkit shop [/url]and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/PAMkVzjSxb]Discord Server[/url] to speak with the community and give us feedbacks on the game!
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/461/149/62969ab73d828e018f474782d13ed3be_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1645716195&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=aba0680fafdb4c82982f5b55b3267afb[/img]
Hard working team
 
Have a wonderful day,
-The Hibernian Workshop Team

notes.title: Astral Update - January 2022
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to 2022 🎉 [/h1]
We hope you spent a good time during the holidays! On our side, the studio members took a well deserved holiday break and had a great time. We feel reinvigorated and we are very motivated for this [b]upcoming exciting year to work on Astral Ascent[/b]!

[h1]New playtest version is here! 🔥[/h1]
How to better start the year than with a brand [b]new Playtest version[/b]? We have been delaying this new version as we wanted to do a [b]major update[/b] with polished content before collecting your thoughts about it, this new version includes:
 [list]
[*]the Red barrens (second world of the game) with new enemies / challenges
[*]5 new bosses to face (Virgo, Leo, Sagittarius, Lupus & Pegasus)
[*]3 new room types to discover
[*]2 new hub NPCs to meet with new progression systems
[*]10+ new Auras
[*]13 new spells to use
[*]and plenty more...
[/list]

You can check the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/3122683923030600048][b]dedicated patch-note here[/b][/url], it is probably not complete as the update was so massive but we tried to be exhaustive.
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/068/517/3a28e0c966be5b5fee1abfc6cd4d3584_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1642182965&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=25de3d6bfd326c50c4949bcdf2894b8aAyla in the Red Barrens[/img]
[i]Virgo, Sagittarius and Leo[/i]
 
[h3]How to participate? [/h3]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/065/634/dde4ea57ce4f1d78756e7fb96bef98cf_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1642157286&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=6324038dbf96104bfe40ee4f4bc56416[/img]
You need to have the [b]Playtest app unlocked on your Steam account[/b], if you already have it the new version will update automatically, if you do not have it already:
[list]
[*]Join our [url=http://discord.gg/hibernian-workshop][b]Discord Server[/b][/url] and follow our Kickstarter Assistant instructions in the [b]#kickstarter-rewards channel[/b] to get your [b]backer Discord role[/b].
[*]React in the [b]#playtests-register channel[/b] to get the [b]Playtester role[/b]. 
[*]Welcome to the [b]#playtests channel[/b] where you can [b]ask for a key[/b].
[*]Use the key in Steam.
[/list]


[h3]Can I keep my saves from previous Playtest?[/h3]
Your last playtest saves will be saved if they were from 0.21.10 or more, if you lost your saves you can now  [b]press LB and RB while launching the game to skip the intro tutorial[/b].

[h3]Can I help you or share my thoughts? [/h3]
We have created [url=https://forms.gle/vY9NrvW4tesz8tzh6][b]a new survey here[/b][/url] to [b]collect your thoughts about this new version[/b]. We have improved the game a lot thanks to your previous feedbacks so thank you if you take the time to answer it this time again. You can also create suggestions tickets in the [b]#suggestions channel[/b] of the Discord Server.
[b]Unlisted commented Youtube videos [/b](without comments is fine too) are [b]extremely appreciated[/b] so we can better see how you react to the game elements.


[h3]New level elements - the Red barrens is complete![/h3]
The second world of the game is now [b]content complete[/b], we have recently added [b]new traps[/b] that will appear on the explorations room to make those rooms more dangerous and lively. We did not want to add traps at the beginning of the development but we love how it turned out.
You'll see that they also are [b]tools to deal damages[/b] to your enemies.
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/065/298/54a6058a4497b9a8cb763d441319c069_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1642154150&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=96de0d20076d8aaa4a2f04a229b6e093Fire geysers[/img]
[i]Fire geysers[/i]
 
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/065/305/01c24e1a83d06be43ea92016cb347567_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1642154238&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=ae2cdd7a100727ddb2b930d0bcab57cdFire Statue[/img]
[i]Fire Statue[/i]
 
We have also added [b]new traps in the Fragmented Plains[/b] (first world), these elements only appear in the Exploration rooms to make them feel more unique and more rhythmed.
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/065/824/92daa644da05ac04f03e6764f4f863c6_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1642159279&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=9ee0e7a822d94ae94566fe0bb098eae4Carnivorous Plant[/img]
[i]Carnivorous Plant[/i]
 


[h3]New unique auras - new gimmick effects[/h3]
For some time, we felt that Auras lacked funny and gameplay-changing elements, we decided to work on this giving [b]unique gimmicks[/b] to work with and create [b]combo with other effects[/b]! There is plenty of new Auras to discover and new interesting combos between the Auras or between Auras and Gambits, we hope you'll like them as much as we do!
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/065/321/14ea27d7b6e53ed516bbd8bac545ff53_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1642154390&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=202238ae16b6eaadb3155290d353323fAura combo explosive dash + fire projectiles[/img]
[i]Aura combo explosive dash + fire projectiles[/i]
 
[h3]Achievements and Auras NPCs 🐲[/h3]
We have also added new content to the main hub: [b]Two new NPCs have joined the cast[/b]!
The first one is a familiar face, [b]Sieur Bapy[/b] from the Kickstarter stretch goals has finally arrived at the hub and will now [b]keep track of your achievements[/b] and even giving you [b]extra rewards to help you[/b] during your journey.
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/065/335/05504d24602eb6dc341cfd4ae96302e9_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1642154459&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=1b996ab388c9d0aa415143cb604089b8Sieur Bapy Achievement menu[/img]
[i]Sieur Bapy Achievement menu[/i]
 
The second one is a[b] mysterious and ancient being[/b] that everyone named [b]Dragon[/b] for obvious reasons. You will now be able to get  [b]access to new auras[/b] to unlock during your next adventures!
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/065/340/d92c030d749cf25687a8f6ca52919d4c_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1642154486&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=7672190e1708c28d59e576b347703f0cAura NPC[/img]
[i]Aura NPC[/i]
 

[h3]World balancing changes and Salvage mechanic[/h3]
One of the main changes we have made since the previous version is changing the structure of the runs:

[list]
[*]  [b]Fight rooms will now exclusively give keys[/b] - merchants became much more important
[*]  [b]Higher tier loots are rarer than before [/b]- collecting gambits became more interesting
[*]  [b]Exploration rooms have been shortened [/b]- experience is more dynamic all around
[/list]
Those changes implied a lot of changes on progression during runs and, if you try the new version, you will see that it's quite different from what we had before, all of[b] your feedbacks regarding thoses changes are welcomed[/b]!
Among the progression changes, we decided to add a [b]salvage mechanic[/b] to the game, giving you the possibility to [b]salvage unwanted spells/gambits and tranform them into quartz[/b] to use in the next shop, you can also [b]salvage Auras into difficulty stars[/b].
It is now always exciting to find these rewards because if they are not fitting your current build you will still get currency to invest in something you need for your build at next merchant.
 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/065/927/12bb4a964ddf30c493e8b23cf7a66e30_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1642160089&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=79c4aab32dfaad17f41a4eed43ac7b2e[/img]

 
We really hope you will appreciate all this new content as much as we do. 
Don't forget our [url=https://astral-ascent.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders#store]Backerkit shop[/url] and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/PAMkVzjSxb]Discord Server[/url] to speak with the community and give us feedbacks on the game!
 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/050/263/62969ab73d828e018f474782d13ed3be_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1642006403&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=bc9582c6100c507910c94ac828caa514Hard working team[/img]
[i]Hard working team[/i]
 
Have a wonderful day,

-The Hibernian Workshop Team

notes.title: Astral Update - September 2021
notes.notes:
[h1]Painted figure preview[/h1]
During last update, we made a poll to get your opinion about having [b]Ayla fully painted[/b] (for no extra cost) and making it available on our [url=https://astral-ascent.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders#store]Backerkit store[/url] to cover the additional costs from manufacturer. 
[b]You were 98.2% voting yes[/b]! So the figure is [b]available again on the store[/b]. 
We also received the first pictures, not final, from Limited Run Games manufacturer painted version and [b]we love it[/b]!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/034/967/532/2dfb32e86f0e33a16c5fcefc852d15ab_original.jpeg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&auto=compress%2Cformat&q=1&w=700&fit=max&v=1632306143&frame=1&s=207bef9973cb922a5d5a9f8d49d63fbf[/img]
[i]preview of Ayla painted figure (21cm height), not final![/i]

[h1]New Playtest version is here - 0.21.0[/h1]
Thanks so much to everyone [b]who joined our Playtests sessions[/b] on our [url=http://discord.gg/hibernian-workshop]Discord Server[/url]. We registered [b]171 unique testers[/b] and 56 of you took time to answer our gameplay survey. [b]This helped us a lot[/b]! 
Playstests allow us to[b] understand the strengths and weaknesses of the game[/b] and [b]a lot of changes were made according to the feedbacks we received[/b]. Seeing many people sharing an opinion confirms that something needs to be changed on a specific feature. An example of that is that several players reported utility spells were slow to use so we made them instant and you can now do it while performing any other animation and it is much better!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/034/971/491/7c96f3417e772a745bc7ba91e8d112ab_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1632325345&auto=format&frame=1&q=92&s=d482eb571f5281bfaeca008f8d8bace4[/img]
[i]Kiran performing teleport utility spell during one of his attacks[/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/034/967/777/c9027791af98fedb39b501632a90ddc4_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&auto=compress%2Cformat&q=1&w=700&fit=max&v=1632307517&frame=1&s=bb4a4021d33f4267356b472f3df5b0ba[/img]
[i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/2880605296323433373]0.21.0 is here[/url]![/i]

We have just launched [b]0.21.0 on Steam Playtests branch[/b] (visible on game main menu). It also comes with [url=https://forms.gle/Y8P4q1TnALdMRqt37]a new survey[/url] if you have the time to fill it after playing it would be very nice.
To keep track of all the changes that we do, we decided to create [b]Patch notes[/b] for each updates that we make. You can see the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280930/view/2880605296323433373]Patch notes dedicated to this new update here[/url].  This version should be the one used for Steam Next Festival starting October 1st.
These Playtests sessions are like a [b]pre early access[/b] as we are able to collect many meaningful feedbacks and we are training to make frequent and stables updates so we can keep a similar rhythm during Early Access. 

If you have not joined the Playtests yet and want to, please check our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hibernian-workshop/astral-ascent/posts/3285254]previous update[/url] to see the steps to join.

[h1]More news[/h1]
We have created many things for 0.21.0 like[b] new level design elements[/b] that will give more variety to the fights and exploration as you can see below:

[previewyoutube=YU1Mj5Eb1fY;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/034/971/257/1da2f3bfca42f0d820d5c032d5033eaf_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1632324524&auto=format&frame=1&q=92&s=ed763d611e65b7b07de6aa7e8a0e4825[/img]
[i]Exploding Dandelion weaken the enemies defenses[/i]

We have also created a new gambit type that allows you to [b]unlock a gambit slot on a spell[/b]. This will be very useful for long runs to create the best possible builds.

- The Hibernian Workshop Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - September 2021
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37710613/6242ded5473885a37513cb08a5f0e84b1dacae9e.gif[/img]

⭐[i][b]Changes inspired by our community![/b][/i]

[h2]Major Features[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Added new GAMBIY SLOT UNLOCKER: [/b]New loot type that can be used to unlock a locked gambit spell slot
[/list]
[h2]Small Features[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]New icon for intro rooms
[hr][/hr][*]Crystal shard altar in merchant room and astral chest + difficulty points altar in rest room
[hr][/hr][*]New visual assets in the Garden
[hr][/hr][*]No more stuck on loading screen if player has outdated data
[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ Changed dialog characters brightness to be smoother
[hr][/hr][*]Utility spells do not have animations anymore
[hr][/hr][*]Capricorn books should be easier to hit now
[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ [b]Magnect attack revamp: [/b]Players have more control towards targets of magnect attacks. Flying enemies should also be easier to hit now.
[hr][/hr][*]New level progress icons for intro world rooms
[hr][/hr][*]Change of camera movement when falling and jumping to be smoother
[hr][/hr][*]Players can move during first frames of all common spells and some signature spells
[hr][/hr][*]When hurt in air, hurt animation is one frame smaller to feel smoother
[hr][/hr][*]Spells icons are better displayed when inspecting spell at merchant
[hr][/hr][*]New animations for botanist
[hr][/hr][*]Small yalees randomly spawning in the hub
[hr][/hr][*]Yalee tickets are found only after unlocking Papa Yalee NPC
[hr][/hr][*][b]Astral Chest: [/b]Spawned only if player has at least one key in inventory; Reworked the smaller reward
[hr][/hr][*]New animation on characters for certain common spells
[hr][/hr][*]New UI tutorial for first time aquiring a Zodiac summon
[hr][/hr][*][b]Summon Zodiac: [/b]Summon ready is not displayed at each new room anymore
[hr][/hr][*]Tweaked readibility for uSpell cooldown
[hr][/hr][*]Better lisibility on merchant assistant feedback when reseting spells
[hr][/hr][*]Improved lisibility for spell loot descriptions
[hr][/hr][*]New UI tutorial for helping changing body part colors using the Stylist
[hr][/hr][*]Improved quality of icons at the botanist
[hr][/hr][*]Improved visual feedback of Sylvanian Protector melee attack
[hr][/hr][*]Added white outline of fireballs spell in tutorial
[hr][/hr][*]Utility spell loots also have an outline like other spells so they are more visible
[hr][/hr][*]Small improviments on intro tutorial
[hr][/hr][*]Fight room portals now have feedback about how many key rewards will be received in the room
[hr][/hr][*][b]Botanist ability rework - ""Pocket Money EXTRA!!"": [/b]Now player gains a % of current crystal as bonus after picking a new room
[hr][/hr][*]Changed formula to calculate rarity tier of a spell
[hr][/hr][*]Added feedback to modificator description and loot depending on its rarity
[hr][/hr][*]Mana & Health orbs are now more visible and more spaced when displayed on ground
[hr][/hr][*]Now possible to preview spells sold by itnerant merchant
[hr][/hr][*]Healing shards loot are now more visible
[hr][/hr][*]Improved UI healing shard icon lisibility
[hr][/hr][*]Crystal currency is now easier to pick up when in air after defeating an enemy
[hr][/hr][*][b]Jump Crystal LD ingredient: [/b]Added a period of no auto-attack after hitting a crystal and it now requires you to face the crystal or be close enough of it to trigger it
[hr][/hr][*]Taurus should now always be the first boss you meet in world 1
[hr][/hr][*]New menu option to enable or disable data collection from players
[hr][/hr][*]Crystal spot altars now disappear
[hr][/hr][*]Started adding vibrations for controllers to the game
[hr][/hr][*]New feedback on UI when equipping a spell to try to make it more clear
[hr][/hr][*]Aerial tutorial hints were slightly changed - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.1[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Gambit hint by Ikki in intro room was reworked - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.1[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Gambit rarity was not displayed at the itinerant merchant - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.1[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Improved elite feedback for sharpshooter modificator  - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.1[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Astro fruit trees now have a title related to their current fruit - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.1[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Added a mushroom in introduction room - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.3[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Fireballs and Ice thrower spells are not launched from middle of characters so you do not miss anymore if enemies are too close - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.4[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Made Mushroom spore attack a bit more feedbacked - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.4[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]New special event very rarely in fight rooms - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.4[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Bosses teleport effect improved - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.4[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Taurus waits slightly longer to attack after teleportation - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.4[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Improviment on pinata enemy behavior - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.5[/b][/i]
[/list]
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Enemies groups that spawn in battle room have been balanced
[hr][/hr][*]Big mushroom enemy health has been reduced
[hr][/hr][*]Improved cast time of Toxic Bomb spell
[hr][/hr][*]Capricorn is now more aggressive and a bit more dangerous
[hr][/hr][*]Healing shards altar now cost a bit more but gives 5 healing shards everytime
[hr][/hr][*]Made gambits on spells less frequent and unlocked gambit slots more frequent
[hr][/hr][*]Reduced the spell loot chance on enemies defeated - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.1[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Increased the loot chances of memory fragments and yalee tickets - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.1[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Summon Zodiac bar now requires 30 mana used instead of 15 - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.1[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Improved Kiran attacks hitbox - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.1[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Some enemies in World 1 move less backward while taking hits - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.1[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Sylvanian thorns come out of ground faster - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.3[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Reduced overall number of enemies that can spawn in exploration rooms - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.4[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Merchant assistant reset price is not evolving anymore - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.4[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Elites now only drop gambits instead of spells and gambits - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.4[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Increased the amount of crystals found as end of levels reward - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.4[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Flying dummies now move less in up and down to make them easier to hit - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.4[/b][/i]
[/list]
[h2]Level Design[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]18 new exploration rooms have been added!
[hr][/hr][*]Bouncing mushroom will now appear in rooms.
[hr][/hr][*]Astro fruit will now appear in rooms.
[hr][/hr][*]Explosive dandelion will now appear in rooms.
[hr][/hr][*]Older exploration rooms have been reworked
[hr][/hr][*]Challenge rooms side walls were not large enough and it could glitch a little with shakescreen - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.1[/b][/i]
[/list]
[h2]Music & SFX[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Various additions to SFX for common & utility spells
[hr][/hr][*]Each character has specific sound designs when hitting enemies with basic attacks
[hr][/hr][*]Added sound designs on Taurus fight
[hr][/hr][*]Stone altar was playing SFX many times while above a stone - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.1[/b][/i]
[/list]
[h2]Narrative Design[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Most dialogs reworked and new dialogs added
[hr][/hr][*]Replaced name of Relics by Auras in the game
[/list]
[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Made save progression icon more visible
[hr][/hr][*][i][b][u]community inspired[/u][/b][/i] ⭐ [b]Constellation UI: [/b]Now explains what are the changes to be expected when picking a constellation
[hr][/hr][*]Swapped LT (utility spell) & RT (healing shards) on default controls
[hr][/hr][*]Added a warning to not quit while save progress icon is displayed.
[hr][/hr][*]Changed order of constellations on the dedicated interface
[hr][/hr][*]Changed default summoning input from L3 to R3
[hr][/hr][*]Slighty changed the - End of demo message - to better fit the terms of the game - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.1[/b][/i]
[hr][/hr][*]Changed data deletion warning message text - ☄️ [i][b]hotfix[/b][/i] [i][b] 0.21.1[/b][/i]
[/list]

[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Missing platform in a specific room
